title: Vil du bygge strukturen som gjør et globalt, bærekraftig teknologiselskap klart for neste vekstfase?
description:
ECOsubsea har kommet langt takket være høy fleksibilitet, sterk gjennomføringskraft og evne til å løse utfordringer raskt. Når vi nå skalerer både flåte og geografi, trenger vi deg som elsker å sette ting i system – uten at vi mister smidigheten vår.

Du vil rapportere direkte til CFO, jobbe svært tett i spann med Operations Manager, og være en viktig sparringspartner og avlastning for CEO i strategiske ekspansjonsprosjekter. Der den daglige driften håndterer det akutte og sørger for at oppdragene leveres, vil du bygge de repeterbare og skalerbare arbeidsflytene som fjerner flaskehalser («growth blockers») og sikrer full kostnadskontroll.

Dine viktigste ansvarsområder
  • Prosessdesign og standardisering: Kartlegge, designe, implementere og eie standardiserte arbeidsprosesser (SOP-er) på tvers av drift, innkjøp og logistikk.
  • Kontinuerlig forbedring (LEAN): Identifisere flaskehalser og prioritere tiltak der gevinsten innen effektivisering og kostnadsreduksjon er størst.
  • Ekspansjonsprosjekter: Avlaste ledergruppen i strategiske og operasjonelle prosjekter knyttet til internasjonal vekst.
  • Innkjøp, lager og ressursplanlegging: Etablere bedre struktur, rutiner og kostnadskontroll innen innkjøp, leverandøroppfølging og lagerstyring, samt strømlinjeforme produksjons- og ressursplanlegging rundt våre ROV-operasjoner.
  • Timefangst og effektivisering: Sikre presis timefangst og kostnadsfordeling per prosess og kunde for å identifisere forbedringsområder i operativ drift.
  • Digitalisering og AI: Være en aktiv pådriver for smart bruk av vårt ERP-system (Odoo) og AI-verktøy (som Claude) for å automatisere oppgaver og forbedre arbeidsflyten.
  • Endringsledelse: Sikre god forankring, opplæring og etterlevelse av nye rutiner og systemer på tvers av organisasjonen.
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en praktiker med solid forretningsforståelse – ikke en ren teoretiker. Du evner å se det store bildet og komplekse sammenhenger i verdikjeden, samtidig som du har øye for detaljene som avgjør om en prosess faktisk fungerer i hverdagen.

 

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning (bachelor/master) innen logistikk, økonomi, ingeniørfag, prosjektledelse eller tilsvarende (solid og dokumentert realkompetanse kan kompensere).
  • Dokumenterbar, praktisk erfaring med prosessforbedring (gjerne LEAN eller tilsvarende) fra operativ virksomhet.
  • Solid erfaring innen ett eller flere av områdene produksjonsplanlegging, innkjøp, lagerstyring eller verdikjede/logistikk.
  • Sterk digital forståelse og god erfaring med bruk og optimalisering av ERP-systemer (gjerne Odoo eller tilsvarende).
  • Høy nysgjerrighet og praktisk erfaring med bruk av AI-verktøy (som Claude/ChatGPT) for effektivisering og problemløsning.
  • Flytende fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Det er en fordel dersom du har variert erfaring fra selskaper i vekst eller endring, bakgrunn fra maritim næring, offshore, subsea eller industriell produksjon, eller erfaring med internasjonale operasjoner og etablering av nye lokasjoner.

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Strukturert og helhetsorientert: Du trives med å skape orden og bygge skalerbare systemer i et miljø med høyt tempo.
  • Gjennomføringssterk og sluttførende: Du har høy arbeidskapasitet og nøyer deg ikke med gode planer – du sørger for at endringer blir rullet ut og forankret.
  • Tøff og trygg i deg selv: Du våger å ta din plass, utfordre etablerte sannheter og stå i motstand når nye rutiner skal innføres.
  • Analytisk og kommersiell: Du prioriterer tydelig basert på kost/nytte og holder hodet kaldt når det koker rundt deg.
  • Endringsorientert og samlende: Du motiverer og får med deg både ledelse og operativt personell på nye måter å jobbe på.
Hvorfor velge ECOsubsea?
  • En nøkkelrolle i internasjonal vekst: Du får en svært sentral posisjon i et norsk teknologiselskap med global rekkevidde, midt i en fase med flåteutvidelse og internasjonal ekspansjon.
  • Stor påvirkningskraft og vekstmuligheter: Hos oss er det kort vei fra idé til beslutning. Du får et tydelig mandat til å forme hvordan selskapet skal rigges og drives i årene som kommer – med spennende utviklingsmuligheter i takt med selskapets videre vekst.
  • Teknologisk i front: Du blir en del av en offensiv organisasjon som aktivt utnytter moderne ERP-løsninger og kunstig intelligens i praktisk drift.
  • Engasjert arbeidsmiljø: Du vil jobbe tett med dyktige, uformelle og ambisiøse kolleger som brenner for det vi skaper sammen.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ECOsubsea AS er en ledende og innovativ aktør innen miljøvennlig og helautomatisert skrogvask for den globale shippingindustrien. Med vår egenutviklede ROV-teknologi renser vi skipsskrog skånsomt, samler opp alt biologisk avfall for å hindre spredning av fremmede arter, og bidrar til lavere drivstofforbruk og reduserte klimagassutslipp.

 

Fra hovedkontoret vårt i Bergen styrer vi operasjoner i et internasjonalt marked med høyt tempo. Nå går vi inn i en spennende fase, og forbereder skalering til bla. nye lokasjoner.

For å rigge oss for denne veksten søker vi nå en handlekraftig og strukturert Project Manager som skal eie, standardisere og videreutvikle selskapets kjerneprosesser

title: Shape Quality for Next-Generation AI Infrastructure
description:
About the Role (Job Purpose)

We are seeking a QA Manager to help establish and maintain the quality and document-control framework supporting Nordscale’s mission-critical data centre operations. As Nordscale is building its operating organisation, you will have the opportunity to shape practical quality processes, controlled documentation and ways of working from an early stage.

You will ensure that operational and technical information is controlled, traceable, approved, accessible and audit-ready, while helping the organisation identify and implement the quality management arrangements required by applicable customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, the Process Specialist and other technical functions, you will provide quality governance around procedures, records, changes and non-conformities. Technical and operational owners remain accountable for technical content, approvals and corrective work.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Help establish and continuously improve the quality and document-control framework across operations, maintenance, engineering and compliance.
  • Manage controlled documents throughout their lifecycle, from creation and approval to publication and archiving.
  • Maintain document registers, standards and traceability across controlled information.
  • Govern document control for SOPs, MOPs, EOPs and technical work instructions.
  • Coordinate audit readiness and ensure relevant evidence and records are available and traceable.
  • Define and maintain the requirements and processes for managing non-conformities and corrective actions.
  • Ensure operational changes are documented, approved and reflected in controlled documentation.
  • Monitor quality and compliance trends to identify areas for improvement.
  • Work with Operations and Engineering to embed practical quality controls.
About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance in data centres, energy, oil and gas, industrial plants, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or another technically complex and audited environment.

You combine strong structure and attention to detail with enough technical understanding to work credibly with engineering and operations teams. You are comfortable helping to build fit-for-purpose quality processes in an organisation that is still developing its systems and ways of working.

Key Characteristics
  • Structured and rigorous, with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
  • Comfortable challenging gaps in process or evidence while working constructively with operational teams.
  • Collaborative and pragmatic, able to translate quality requirements into workable practices.
  • Analytical and improvement-oriented, using findings and trends to prevent recurrence.
Skills & Qualifications
  • Relevant experience in quality assurance, quality systems, document control or compliance within a technical or regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of document control, revision management, traceability, compliance and audit requirements.
  • Experience establishing, implementing or improving practical quality processes and controlled documentation.
  • Good digital skills and experience with electronic document or quality management systems.
  • Strong interest in exploring and applying LLMs to improve workflows, processes and quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik.
Nice to Have
  • Experience from data centres or other mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting ISO 9001 or comparable management systems; exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 14001 or ISO 45001 is also relevant.
  • Experience with SOP, MOP and EOP governance in live technical operations.
  • Experience from engineering, maintenance or asset-management environments and the handover of as-built, O&M or commissioning documentation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in Norwegian.
What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
  • The opportunity to shape the quality framework and operating standards of a growing AI infrastructure environment.
  • A cross-functional role with close exposure to Operations, Engineering and technical specialists.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.
Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Application and Contact

Apply by submitting your CV through the application portal. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

title: Build the Future of AI Infrastructure in Northern Norway
description:
About the Role (Job Purpose) 

We are seeking an Operational Process Specialist to strengthen the performance, resilience and continuous improvement of mechanical, electrical and process systems in a mission-critical data centre environment. 

In this role, you will take ownership of operational procedures and help ensure they reflect the technical environment, operational best practice, and the way work is carried out in practice. You will work closely with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to improve processes and support safe, efficient and reliable operations. 

This is an opportunity to help shape the procedures and technical standards behind a growing AI infrastructure environment, with broad exposure across disciplines and a clear impact on day-to-day operations. 

 

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities) 

  • Analyse and optimise the performance of mechanical, electrical and process systems. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, resilience and operational performance. 
  • Own the technical and operational content of procedures and support their implementation in day-to-day operations. 
  • Develop and improve the technical content of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) and work instructions together with relevant specialists. 
  • Collaborate with Operations, Engineering and technical specialists to ensure critical infrastructure operates safely, efficiently and within design parameters. 
  • Support change management by assessing operational impacts and validating process changes before implementation. 
  • Review operational data, completed work, deviations and current practices to identify improvement opportunities. 
  • Provide technical input to audits, compliance activities and continuous improvement programmes. 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience) 

You may currently be working in technical operations, facilities, maintenance, process improvement or engineering support, with experience from data centres or another technically complex environment such as industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals or manufacturing. 

You have broad technical understanding and enjoy working across disciplines, understanding how systems interact and finding practical ways to improve their operation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline. What matters is that you see the bigger picture, work effectively with technical specialists and take a structured approach to processes, quality and documentation. 

 

Key Characteristics 

  • Passionate about operational excellence and continuous improvement. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach. 
  • Calm under pressure and able to make informed decisions within mission-critical environments. 
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. 
  • Collaborative and able to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering and operational teams. 
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and committed to delivering high operational standards. 
  • Safety-focused with a strong understanding of critical infrastructure risk management.

  • Relevant experience operating, maintaining or optimising mechanical, electrical or process systems. 
  • Broad technical understanding and the ability to see how different systems interact. 
  • Experience from technical environments where reliability and operational continuity are critical. 
  • Experience developing or improving operational procedures and technical work instructions. 
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
  • Ability to work on-site in Bjerkvik, outside Narvik. 

Nice to Have

  • Experience from data centres, industrial plants, energy facilities, oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing or similar technically complex environments. 
  • Relevant technical education or qualifications; equivalent practical experience is also valued. 

What We Can Offer You 

  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The opportunity to influence operational processes, procedures and technical standards in a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure environment. 
  • A cross-disciplinary role combining technical understanding, process optimisation and continuous improvement. 

  • Relocation package if required. 

     

Equal Opportunities Statement 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. 

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Shopfloor & Client Relations / Sales & Curating
description:
Shopfloor & Client Relations / Sales & Curating

Vil du jobbe med unike one-of-one-plagg, vintage og noen av verdens mest ettertraktede fashion- og luxury brands? i SUSTAIN er et kuratert fashion- og resale-konsept med fokus på personlig stil, kvalitet og fremtidens måte å handle mote på.

Hos oss møtes contemporary second hand, luxury og vintage i et moderne fashion-univers.

Vi søker en utadvendt, verbal og kommersielt sterk person med solid salgserfaring, som ønsker å bli en viktig del av i SUSTAIN og utvikle seg sammen med oss over tid.

Hos oss handler salg om mer enn selve plagget.

Du må kunne se kunden, forstå produktet og skape den riktige matchen mellom de to – gjennom produktkunnskap, styling, historiefortelling og god service.

Dette er først og fremst en salgs- og kunderettet rolle.

Kunden kommer alltid først.

Du tar naturlig kontakt, starter samtaler og er genuint nysgjerrig på mennesker.

Du stiller gode spørsmål, lytter, forstår behov, styler og anbefaler – med mål om å skape gode kundeopplevelser og salg.

Du liker mennesker – og mennesker liker å møte deg.

Du er karismatisk, positiv og sosialt trygg, skaper lett kontakt og får kunden til å føle seg sett og velkommen.

Målet er at kunden ikke bare skal huske hva de kjøpte, men hvordan det føltes å være hos oss – og ha lyst til å komme tilbake og møte deg igjen.

Rollen En viktig del av rollen er å være en tydelig og engasjerende formidler av i SUSTAIN.

Du skal kunne fortelle om konseptet vårt på en enkel og inspirerende måte, formidle aktuelle kampanjer og relevant informasjon om innlevering, og gjøre det lett for kunden å forstå mulighetene hos oss.

Du følger også opp kunder skriftlig på e-post og i våre digitale kanaler, og kommuniserer profesjonelt, varmt og tydelig.

Rollen innebærer oppfølging av salg, kundebestillinger, varer og returer på tvers av våre kanaler, samt digital veiledning av kunder ved behov.

Du tar ansvar for detaljene og sørger for at ting blir fulgt opp helt i mål.

Du vil jobbe aktivt mot salgs- og omsetningsmål, følge med på salgsutviklingen og bidra med konkrete initiativer som kan skape aktivitet, styrke kundeopplevelsen og drive salg.

Du trives med høyt tempo, har god situasjonsforståelse og beholder oversikten når flere ting skjer samtidig.

Når du ikke er opptatt med kunder, tar du initiativ til det som må gjøres på shopfloor – blant annet klargjøring av varer og varepåfyll, slik at nye plagg raskt blir presentert og gjort tilgjengelige for salg.

Som en del av rollen får du også opplæring i curating og produktvurdering, og vil kunne bidra med dette ved behov.

Du vil i tillegg kunne bidra med innhold fra butikkhverdagen, produkter og styling til våre sosiale kanaler, og må være komfortabel både foran og bak kamera.

Du kan også bidra med enklere visuelt materiell og kundekommunikasjon i Canva til butikk og våre digitale flater.

Vi ser etter

deg som:

  • har dokumentert erfaring med aktivt og relasjonsdrevet salg
  • er utadvendt, verbal og sosialt trygg, og skaper naturlig kontakt og tillit
  • er genuint nysgjerrig på mennesker, lytter godt og forstår ulike kundebehov

title: Partnership Manager
description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns our partners into a steady source of new customers.

The role in short

We have 3 to 5 prospective partners who could bring us customers. Today we don't work with them in a structured way. You change that. You own every partner relationship, build the method for how we work together, and make things happen.

  • Use the data to double down on the partners that bring in ICP opportunities.

If you want a partner program that's already built, with a playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here.

  • Starting at NOK 750,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

  • Real impact. You build the partner channel from scratch, and in a team this size, it visibly moves the company.

Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content. Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis. Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience. Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time. Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language. By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

title: RETAIL SPECIALIST –  HOME APPLIANCES
employer: WORKSHOP BEMANNING & KOMPETANSE AS AVD OSLO
description:
WorkShop is now looking for a Retail Specialist for our client Samsung within the Home Appliances category, covering the Oslo region as well as the rest of Norway. We are looking for someone with a strong passion for retail, sales and technology, who is highly driven and has a natural ability to inspire, engage and motivate others. You enjoy building long-term relationships and have a genuine interest in Samsung and its innovative product range.

As a Retail Specialist for Samsung, you will be an important brand ambassador, responsible for strengthening Samsung's position among retailers in your assigned district. You will work closely with retail staff through regular store visits, product and sales training sessions, and various sales-driving activities. An important part of your role is to ensure that retail staff have the right knowledge, confidence and tools to present and sell Samsung's Home Appliances products in the best possible way.

You will also be responsible for ensuring that Samsung's products and brand are presented in an attractive and consistent way in stores. This includes making sure that displays and demonstration products are up to date, properly maintained and functioning as intended. Your workplace will vary between different stores and locations, and you will independently plan and manage your daily work in close collaboration with Samsung colleagues and retail staff. In addition to your regular store visits, the role may involve product launches, events, exhibitions and other promotional activities. You will work towards set targets, follow up on your activities and report relevant results and market insights according to established routines.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct regular and planned store visits to retailers within your assigned district

  • Educate, inspire and update retail staff on Samsung's Home Appliances products, product launches and unique selling points (USPs)

  • Plan and deliver product and sales training sessions, both individually and in groups

  • Motivate and support retail staff to actively recommend and sell Samsung products

  • Ensure that Samsung products, displays and demonstration areas are presented to a high standard and follow current guidelines

  • Drive sell-out through sales activities, product demonstrations and promotional initiatives

  • Participate in product launches, events, exhibitions and other marketing activities

  • Gather market insights, monitor competitor activities and identify opportunities for improvement in stores

  • Document and report completed activities and results according to established routines

We believe you are someone who:

  • Have at least two years of experience in retail, field sales or a similar role, preferably within Home Appliances, consumer electronics or a related industry

  • Have a genuine interest in technology and Home Appliances, such as washing machines, refrigerators and other kitchen appliances

  • Are inspiring and have a natural ability to educate, coach and motivate others

  • Have excellent presentation skills and feel comfortable speaking in front of both small and large groups

  • Have a strong sales mindset and understand how to drive sales performance in retail

  • Are self-driven, structured and proactive, with strong organizational and time management skills

  • Are outgoing, service-minded and confident in building strong and long-lasting relationships

  • Are flexible, solution-oriented and enjoy a varied role with a fast-paced working environment

  • Have good administrative skills and are comfortable with reporting and follow-up

  • Have good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

  • Are fluent in Norwegian and English, both verbally and in writing

  • Hold a valid B driving licence

  • Are able to travel and stay away from home multiple days at the time

We offer you an exciting and varied role representing one of the world's leading technology brands, in an international and dynamic working environment. We look forward to hearing from you!

Additional information

Working hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday. Weekend work may occur in connection with events and special activities

Employment: Full-time, permanent position with an initial probationary period

Location: Oslo area, Norway

Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement

The recruitment process is ongoing, and interviews will be conducted continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your application through the application link. The last day to apply is 2026-11-30.

You will be employed by WorkShop, not by any specific client. Depending on business needs, you may work for different clients throughout your employment with us.

We are WorkShop: the Consumer Experience Agency – a leading retail agency in the Nordics, dedicated to creating and delivering innovative customer experience for the world's biggest brands. We do that by offering a complete portfolio of services including data & insights, concept, field marketing and much more – so that we can be a partner to our clients in every step. Join one of our teams around the globe and explore your potential through unique projects, pop-ups, store concepts or our brand ambassador programs!

Learn more about our company at WorkShop and follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram!

Workshop is a global retail agency building brands for the here and now. From screens to stores to the people behind your brand, every impression counts.

title: Executive Assistant and Management Support
employer: THE ASSOCIATION FOR THE EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES TRANSPARENCY INITIATIVE (EITI)
description:
Who are we?

Founded on the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) brings together governments, civil society and companies to improve natural resource governance. With over 50 member countries and 60 supporting companies, the EITI promotes transparency, accountability and informed policymaking in the extractive sector. 

Behind this ambitious and impactful organisation is a diverse and dynamic team of experts working together to advance the EITI mission. Based in Oslo, Norway, the EITI International Secretariat comprises a collaborative, multinational and multilingual team of around 60 professionals who value growth and development, strong relationships, open dialogue and inclusive leadership.

What are we looking for

We are seeking an Oslo-based, experienced and highly organised person to support the Executive Director and Board Chair. The successful candidate will have strong interpersonal and organisational skills and exercise discretion and confidentiality when handling correspondence and other sensitive information.The role requires excellent time management and the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail. A proactive approach to problem-solving, a willingness to take on a variety of responsibilities and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment are essential. The role will report to the Executive Director. 

Duties and responsibilities
  • Coordinate travel authorisations and confirm budget availability in line with relevant policies.
  • Plan missions with country teams, including travel bookings, visa applications, itineraries and transport.
  • Arrange meetings and compile materials needed for travel and missions.
  • Prepare travel claims and track expenses in accordance with relevant policies.
  • Monitor the Executive Director’s and Board Chair’s inboxes and urgent messages, draft approved correspondence and follow up with staff and EITI stakeholders.
  • Ensure the Executive Director’s leave and working hours are accurately recorded.
  • Maintain and archive the Senior Management Team’s agenda items, and coordinate meeting agendas in line with internal policies.
  • Support engagement with the supporting countries constituency by scheduling meetings and liaising with the Finance Manager on reporting and budget queries.
  • Schedule Senior Management Team meetings, invite relevant colleagues and record and communicate decisions and action points.
  • Coordinate Senior Management Team activities, including assistance in organising retreats and the coordination of leave schedules.
  • Provide targeted administrative support across the Secretariat, including assisting the Operations team when needed and helping to coordinate internal events, recognising the close links between the team’s work and support for the Executive Director and Board Chair.
Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration or similar.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as an executive assistant or office administrative assistant.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and digital finance/travel systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new digital systems quickly.
  • Working knowledge of data management and data protection (GDPR) principles.

Desirable:

  • Experience working in an international environment and with international organisations.
  • Working knowledge of French and Spanish.
We can offer

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a multi-stakeholder organisation driving positive global change. 

Located in central Oslo, the EITI International Secretariat offers hybrid work options, attractive benefits and an above-market pension and insurance package. See information about the benefits we offer here.The Secretariat can offer employment in Norway based on the Norwegian salary structure. Indicative gross salary benchmarking suggests a range of NOK 560,000 to NOK 580,000. The final offer will be determined based on factors including the labour market, role requirements, internal equity, budget and the successful candidate’s experience and skills.

This is an Oslo-based role. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in Norway and hold any required work permit before starting the position. Relocation support is not provided.Email applications will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

ContactsJeanette Reinertsen LocationRådhusgata 26 0151 Oslo Key information:Employer: Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) Reference number: 5216177116 Percentage of full-time: 100% Permanent position Application deadline: 11/12/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (EITI) is the global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources.

Guided by the belief that a country’s natural resources belong to its citizens, the EITI has established a global standard to promote the open and accountable management of oil, gas and mineral resources. The EITI Standard requires the disclosure of information along the extractive industry value chain from the point of extraction, to how revenues make their way through the government, and how they benefit the public. By doing so, the EITI seeks to strengthen public and corporate governance, promote understanding of natural resource management, and provide the data to inform reforms for greater transparency and accountability in the extractives sector. In each of the 55 implementing countries, the EITI is supported by a coalition of government, companies, and civil society.

The EITI is committed to achieving diversity in terms of gender, nationality, culture and educational background. The EITI is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Drone Builder / Drone Mechanic
description:
Aviant delivers food and medicine to people's gardens using drones. After starting in the labs at MIT in 2020, we have flown over 10,000 flights, covered tens of thousands of kilometers and currently operate the largest commercial base for last-mile drone delivery in Europe, at Ski just outside Oslo. Demand is growing faster than our fleet, and we now need to build a lot more drones. We are therefore looking for hands-on Drone Builders / Drone Mechanics to join our workshop and help us scale up production.

As a Drone Builder, you will:

  • Build and assemble new drones, from components to flight-ready aircraft

  • Wire, solder and crimp harnesses, connectors and power systems

  • Install and test motors, servos, batteries, flight controllers and other electronics

  • Do composite work, repairs and replacement of airframe parts

  • Run bench tests and quality checks before handing drones over to flight operations

  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on our operational fleet

  • Follow and improve build instructions, checklists and documentation, so every drone is built the same way, every time

  • Find smarter ways to build faster with higher quality (jigs, fixtures, kits, 3D-printed parts)

Relevant technology:

  • Aircraft type: Fixed-wing VTOL, 2.5m wingspan

  • Methods: Soldering, crimping, 3D printing, CNC, metalworking

  • Materials: Composites (CFRP, GFRP), wood, metal, plastic

  • Components: BLDC motors, servos, lithium batteries, flight controllers, PCBs

  • Tools: Multimeter, hand and power tools, technical drawings and CAD

Ideal candidate:

  • Loves to work with your hands and takes pride in doing things properly

  • Extremely structured and detail-oriented. In aviation, small mistakes matter

  • Has practical experience from building or repairing things, such as drones, RC aircraft, cars, bikes, electronics or aircraft

  • Is comfortable with soldering and basic electronics

  • Hungry for results and motivated by seeing your work fly

It's a plus if you have:

  • A trade certificate (fagbrev) or education as e.g. aircraft technician, electrician, automation technician or industrial mechanic

  • Experience with composites, 3D printing or series production

  • Experience from aviation maintenance or other quality-controlled production

No drone experience is required. You will be trained in Aviant's build and maintenance procedures.

What we offer:

  • Work on introducing a new means of transportation into society. Like building the first cars, you can tell your grandkids that "I was part of making this happen"

  • See the drones you build fly real deliveries to customers every week

  • Work in the leading environment in Europe for these systems

  • Large stock option package. When we succeed, we all succeed!

Practical:

  • Position: 100%, on-site

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Location: Ski, Norway (10 min train from Oslo)

  • Language: Norwegian or English

  • Process: A short first interview, followed by a practical hands-on test in our workshop

  • We review applications continuously and hire as soon as we find the right people, so apply early!

If you want to build the drones that make drone delivery a reality, please apply!

description:

Stillingsprosent: 20 - 40%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte.

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

title: PhD Candidate in Translational Research
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

Do you want to contribute to research about non-coding RNAs in sperm health and infertility?

A PhD position is available at the Department of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences in the Translational Vascular Research group, working on the project ´Developmental non-coding RNA signatures of sperm health and infertility´

The Translational Vascular Research group includes both basic scientists and clinicians. We perform research spanning across disciplines, from the analysis of patient samples to laboratory based investigation of cell behaviour. Parts of our research group are based at Karolinska Institute/KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden, with the opportunity for close collaborations with these institutes.The fertility department at the Women’s clinic at the University Hospital of North Norway (UNN) is a collaboration partner and will contribute with expertise in andrology and analysis of semen samples.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD program is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25% each year and will consist of teaching and other duties for the Department of Clinical Medicine. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to a PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position. 

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Male infertility is an increasing global health concern, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying impaired sperm function remain poorly understood. Previously, our group identified more than 2,000 testis-enriched non-coding RNAs and characterised their expression across germ-cell development. In this project, you will investigate which of these non-coding RNAs persist into mature sperm and whether their expression is associated with sperm quality and fertility. In collaboration with the fertility clinic atthe University Hospital of North Norway (UNN), you will analyse sperm samples from fertility patients and healthy donors. Using sperm phenotyping, cell sorting and RNA sequencing, you will examine differences in non-coding RNA expression between sperm populations with different functional characteristics, including motility and morphology. Selected transcripts will also be investigated in matched testicular tissue using imaging and in situ hybridisation to study their expression during germcell development. By integrating molecular and clinical data, the project aims to identify non-coding RNA signatures associated with sperm health and their potential as biomarkers of male fertility.

You must submit a cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests. 

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Professor Lynn Butler 

  • phone: +47 776 25 104
  • email: lynn.m.butler@uit.no
Qualifications

Required Professional Qualifications

  • A Candidate Medicine, or a Master’s degree in biological sciences . If you are near completion of your Master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis. You must document completion of your degree before commencement in the position.
  • Documented fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications, but not required:

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language
  • Prior experience with cell culture-based laboratory projects, bioinformatics is beneficial. The candidate must be flexible and keen to work as part of a larger team.

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

Required Personal Qualifications

  • An enthusiasm for research and learning
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a larger team
  • Willingness to collaborate with others During the assessment, emphasis will be put on your potential, motivation and personal suitability for the position.

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure.

title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

  • Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

  • Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

  • Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

  • Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

  • Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

  • Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

  • A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within an IB World School.

  • Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

  • Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

  • Experience working within multicultural communities.

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Compassionate and approachable.

  • Calm and solution-focused.

  • Collaborative and reflective.

  • Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

  • An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

  • Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

  • Committed to continuous professional learning.

  • Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

  • A welcoming and diverse international community.

  • Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

  • A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

title: Senior scientific project coordinator
employer: NORCE RESEARCH AS AVD NATURVITENSKAP BERGEN
description:
About the position

The research group DARWIN (Data, AI, and Robotics) at the NORCE Technology and digital systems division is looking for a senior scientist in a permanent 100% position with the main role of initiating and coordinating large national and EU research proposals for the research group and scientifically coordinating them as well as designing novel concepts and solutions for AI and robot deployments. The group has strong technological professional expertise in data science, AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics, mechatronics, cybernetics, computer engineering, visual sensing, visualization, advanced maintenance and smart instrumentation.

The place of work and employment can be any NORCE location. Travelling is expected.

Work tasks

The main tasks of the position will be to drive new large national and EU research possibilities, initiate and coordinate scientific proposal writing and applications, carry out the scientific coordination and management of projects within AI and robotics. Additional tasks include carrying out technological research and development projects in collaboration with industrial partners and research organization in Norway and in Europe, as well as collaborative projects with other groups and divisions within NORCE.

Required skills, expertise and experience

  • Scientific background: minimum master’s degree in mechanical electronics, computer science and/or mechatronics or a related scientific area, with extensive knowledge in robotics, AI and perception systems.

  • Documented experience of at least 10 years in national and EU research funding programs with a track record on initiating scientific large national and EU project applications, writing scientific national and EU project proposals and coordinating national and EU projects is particularly relevant to the position.

  • Industrial experience is an advantage

  • Being and having a certified project management with IPMA, PMP or similar

  • Proficiency in English. Knowledge of the Norwegian language is an advantage.

  • Good team working skills while being proactive.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

We offer

  • A good and professionally challenging working environment

  • Exciting interdisciplinary projects together with national and international partners

  • A nationwide network of researchers in NORCE

  • Exciting, varied and flexible workday

  • Interdisciplinary work in teams with experts in other fields

  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development in a new and expansive competence environment

  • A social and creative work environment where you have a large influence on your own workday

  • Good pension and insurance schemes, good welfare schemes and competitive wages

How to apply

Please upload your application by pressing the application button. Your application should be written in English and must include the following:

  • CV

  • A cover letter with a description of your professional qualifications and motivation to apply for the position

  • Names and contact information of two references

  • Copy of diplomas, transcripts and relevant certificates from your higher education

Application deadline: 3 January 2027

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting research leader Nabil Belbachir, tel. 401 08 137, or nabe@norceresearch.no.

At NORCE, we are committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for available positions regardless of gender, age, disability, or ethnic background.

Candidates are expected to openly offer relevant information about themselves during the recruitment process. Furthermore, one can expect background checks to be conducted on candidates in the final phase of the recruitment process. NORCE uses external actors to carry out such background checks.

NORCE is subject to the Security Act and there are strict requirements for our employees to have a security-conscious behavior. For this position, you must satisfy the security clearance requirements for SECRET/NATO SECRET.

Further information about security clearance can be found on the National Security Authority's (NSM) website: NSM.no

title: IT Service Desk Technician
description:
Location: Oslo, Norway

About the role

At Schibsted, reliable IT services are essential to helping our employees do their best work.

We are looking for an IT Service Desk Technician to join our Service Desk team in Oslo, providing high-quality technical support to employees across our organisation, primarily in Norway and Sweden.

Our Service Desk is more than a traditional first-line support function. We resolve approximately 80% of all incoming IT requests and incidents within the team, which means you will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of technical challenges, take ownership of issues and develop your troubleshooting skills.

You will work in an international environment where customer satisfaction, technical expertise and continuous improvement are key priorities. Our IT operations follow IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and ITIL practices, with a strong focus on efficient problem-solving, knowledge sharing and improving the employee IT experience.

Your responsibilities

As an IT Service Desk Technician, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver high-quality IT support: Provide professional, friendly and solution-oriented technical support to employees through phone, email and other support channels.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues: Investigate and resolve incidents involving computers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, access and other workplace technologies.

  • Own incidents and service requests: Register, prioritise, investigate, document and follow up on cases in our ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Halo), taking responsibility for driving issues towards resolution.

  • Ensure a great user experience: Communicate clearly with users, provide regular updates and manage expectations throughout the support process.

  • Drive efficient resolution and knowledge sharing: Contribute to our high resolution rate by developing technical knowledge, documenting solutions and supporting a shift-left approach.

  • Collaborate and continuously improve: Work closely with colleagues and other IT teams to resolve complex issues and improve processes related to Incident, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.

  • Manage IT equipment and suppliers: Support ordering, inventory management and distribution of IT equipment and accessories, including coordination with external suppliers.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes ownership of problems and genuinely likes helping people.

You are curious about technology, comfortable investigating unfamiliar issues and motivated by finding solutions rather than simply passing problems on to someone else.

You enjoy working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where teamwork, knowledge sharing and customer satisfaction are essential.

Skills and knowledge

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • A good understanding of computers, operating systems, software and common workplace IT technologies.

  • The ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a structured and logical way.

  • Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, technologies such as Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

  • An understanding of the importance of documenting incidents, solutions and technical information.

  • The ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with different levels of IT knowledge.

  • Professional proficiency in Norwegian or Swedish, as well as English, both written and spoken.

Nice to have

The following qualifications are an advantage, but not essential:

  • Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk, IT Support or similar technical support role.

  • Around two years of relevant technical experience or education.

  • Experience working with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Halo.

  • Knowledge of ITIL principles and IT Service Management processes.

  • Relevant IT certifications or technical training.

  • Experience with IT equipment management, inventory control or supplier coordination.

  • Experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly using AI to improve IT support, automate tasks, enhance troubleshooting or streamline workflows.

We value practical skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to be considered for the role.

Who you are

We believe the following qualities will help you succeed:

  • Customer oriented: You enjoy helping others, understand their needs and take pride in delivering excellent service.

  • Problem-solving: You approach technical challenges with curiosity, persistence and a structured mindset, taking responsibility for finding solutions.

  • Communication: You explain technical issues clearly, listen actively and keep users informed throughout the support process.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable handling changing priorities, learning new technologies and working in a dynamic IT environment.

  • Collaborative: You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive and supportive team environment.

Why join us?

You will join a Service Desk team in Oslo where technical problem-solving, collaboration and high-quality service go hand in hand.

Unlike traditional first-line support roles, our team handles and resolves the majority of incoming IT issues, giving you the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and technical challenges.

You will support colleagues across Norway and Sweden, work with modern workplace technologies and contribute to continuously improving how IT services are delivered.

We believe great IT support is about more than fixing technical problems. It is about taking ownership, building trust and making people's working lives easier.

As a Control Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in the delivery of control systems for subsea processing projects.

The role combines technical responsibility, stakeholder management, and project execution, giving you ownership of control system scope throughout the project lifecycle.

 

You will contribute to equipment deliveries, technical specifications, documentation reviews, supplier follow-up, system integration activities, and testing. The position offers significant exposure to multidisciplinary EPC projects where collaboration and communication are critical to success.

  • Coordinate technical interfaces between clients, suppliers, and internal engineering disciplines

  • Support equipment deliveries and ensure compliance with project requirements

Personal skills:

You are a proactive and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working in complex, multidisciplinary project environments. Combining strong technical competence with excellent communication skills, you are comfortable engaging with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to drive projects forward.

 

You take ownership of your scope, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and contribute to successful project execution through collaboration, coordination, and technical expertise. title: Thon Gruppen søker Kategorisjef til innkjøpsavdelingen
description:
Thon Gruppen søker en erfaren, analytisk og kommersielt sterk Kategorisjef innkjøp til vår sentrale innkjøpsavdeling. Du blir en del av et team på åtte personer som arbeider med strategisk innkjøp på tvers av konsernets virksomhetsområder. Hovedvekten av innkjøpsaktiviteten er i Norge, men enkelte avtaler og innkjøpsprosesser berører også våre virksomheter i Sverige, Belgia og Nederland.

Om rollen

Som kategorisjef innkjøp leder du strategiske innkjøpsprosesser fra analyse og strategi, til konkurranse, forhandling og implementering. Du får hovedansvar for Mat & Drikke, et område med et innkjøpsvolum på rundt 400 MNOK, og en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle kategorien på tvers av konsernet. Du skal følge opp og videreutvikle kategoristrategien i tett samarbeid med F&B, relevante brukermiljøer og leverandører.

Dine ansvarsområder vil blant annet innebære:

  • Utvikle og følge opp kategoristrategien for mat og drikke, samt lede strategiske innkjøpsprosesser, konkurranser og forhandlinger

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle eksisterende avtaler og leverandørsamarbeid

  • Analysere priser, volum, kostnadsdrivere og markedsutvikling og identifisere og realisere kommersielle forbedringer og besparelser

  • Lede innkjøpsprosjekter i samarbeid med interne fagmiljøer og eksterne aktører

  • Bidra til økt avtalelojalitet og ansvarlige og bærekraftige innkjøp

Mat og drikke vil være ditt viktigste ansvarsområde, men ikke det eneste. Innkjøpsavdelingen arbeider med et bredt spekter av kategorier, og du vil også få mulighet til å lede innkjøpsprosesser innen andre områder.

Muligheter i rollen

I denne rollen får du jobbe med store innkjøpsvolumer og problemstillinger som berører flere deler av konsernet. Innkjøpsavdelingen har en bred kontaktflate, og stillingen gir derfor et godt innblikk i Thon Gruppen og de ulike virksomhetsområdene. Du får samtidig faglig ansvar og handlingsrom til å drive egne prosesser og påvirke hvordan kategorien utvikles videre. Som en del av et kompetent fagmiljø med god samarbeidskultur får du en variert arbeidshverdag med korte beslutningsveier.

Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring med strategisk og kommersielt innkjøp. Du forstår hvordan priser og prismodeller bygges opp, hvilke faktorer som driver kostnadene og hvor de kommersielle handlingsrommene ligger. Du har god forståelse for råvarepriser, volum, logistikk og markedsutvikling og bruker denne innsikten aktivt i konkurranser, forhandlinger og avtaleoppfølging. Kjennskap til mat- og drikkebransjen og relevante leverandørmarkeder er en fordel. Du er analytisk og strukturert, samtidig som du er nysgjerrig, initiativrik og fleksibel. Du tar eierskap, driver prosesser og bygger gode relasjoner med både leverandører og interne fagmiljøer. Du har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk.

Relevant høyere utdanning innen økonomi, innkjøp, logistikk eller tilsvarende er ønskelig, men relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning. Interesse for hvordan AI og digitale verktøy kan brukes til bedre analyser og mer effektive innkjøpsprosesser er en fordel.

Interessert?

GreatPeople bistår Thon Gruppen i denne rekrutteringen. Ta kontakt med Christina Waale Salomaa (cws@greatpeople.no) eller Henriette Warme Drake (hwd@greatpeople.no) dersom du har spørsmål eller behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
