If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, send us a targeted CV in English as soon as possible. It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your resume.For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se or Kristina Gelevska at kga@temp-team.se

title: Mobility Operations Specialist
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description: Job DescriptionWHAT YOU’LL DO We are looking for a Mobility Operations Specialist with a strong focus on Swedish immigration and inbound mobility to support employees relocating to Sweden. This role is critical in ensuring compliance with Swedish immigration regulations and delivering a smooth, well-managed experience for assignees moving into the country. You will act as a key point of contact for inbound assignees, internal stakeholders, and external providers, with Swedish immigration expertise being a core requirement for the role. Key responsibilities     Manage end-to-end inbound mobility cases to Sweden, with a primary focus on immigration     Act as the subject matter expert on Swedish immigration processes, including work permits, residence permits, extensions, and family applications     Coordinate closely with immigration providers, authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant case handling     Advise HR and the business on immigration timelines, risks, and compliance requirements     Support assignment initiation activities such as cost estimates, documentation, assignment letters, and approvals     Ensure ongoing compliance with Swedish immigration, tax, and social security requirements for inbound assignees     Be the main point of contact for assignees, providing clear guidance and support throughout the relocation process     Contribute to continuous improvement of inbound mobility and immigration processes and policies  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will collaborate with HR teams, business leaders, external immigration providers, and Swedish authorities to ensure a seamless relocation experience for inbound employees.  WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with…     Proven experience in global mobility or immigration, with a strong focus on Sweden     Solid knowledge of Swedish immigration legislation and processes      Experience managing inbound employee populations and working with immigration vendors     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills     Fluent in English; Swedish is highly desirable     Experience with mobility or immigration case management systems is a plus     Relevant education within HR, Business Administration, International Relations or a related field.And people who are…     Service-minded and proactive     Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with others     Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases  WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. An example of our benefits:         25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).          H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.          With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and international mobility. JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. This is a full time permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your application today. We will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews continuously, so don’t wait to apply! We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Senior Art Director
description: Natural Cycles is a regulated medical device company that markets like a consumer brand, which is exactly what makes the creative work here harder and better. We are rebuilding the brand to match the science, launching our first wearables, and doing it with a creative team that is being rebuilt at the same time. title: Cyber Security Unit Manager - Identity & Access Management

Through your leadership, you will drive the continued evolution of IAM, ensuring the capability remains effective, scalable and aligned with the future needs of the business. Additional InformationThis is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden. If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English.Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future. WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. title: Junior Technology Engineer-Kromasil

As demand continues to grow globally, Kromasil is a strategic growth area for Nouryon with several ongoing expansion and development projects. title: Senior Software Engineer - AI-Assisted Legacy Modernisation
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description: Job ID: 6886We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Black Ops unit on a full-time, permanent basis. This is the right role for you if you enjoy understanding complex legacy applications and using AI-assisted engineering to modernize them for strategically supported platforms. You combine hands-on development skills with the analytical judgement to challenge AI-generated changes, verify that application behaviour is preserved and deliver maintainable, production-ready software. Ideally, you will also help develop our framework for grounding and constraining AI-generated changes to reduce hallucinations and unsupported assumptions.About our teamMeet the Black Ops team. We support the internal customers and engineers working with Nordea’s Internal Developer Platform, helping teams resolve complex technical challenges when expectations meet reality. You will play a senior, hands-on role in using agentic AI to refactor legacy applications and help development teams adopt modern platforms and DevOps practices. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the framework that makes our AI-assisted workflows more controlled, verifiable and reliable. In this role, your main responsibilities will be:    Analyse legacy applications, including Java systems, to understand their behaviour, dependencies and constraints before refactoring    Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to refactor legacy code for strategically supported platforms while preserving required functionality    Independently review AI-generated changes, challenge unsupported assumptions and verify correctness through code analysis and automated testing    Build and strengthen regression tests to validate application behaviour before and after refactoring    Build and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines that integrate AI-assisted development with automated builds, testing and deployment    Support the rollout of our agentic AI solution across development teams and help them adopt effective, responsible engineering practices    Provide feedback on AI-generated results and help improve the framework’s context grounding, constraints and validation checks to reduce hallucinations and unintended changes    Collaborate with application developers, architects and platform teams to resolve complex modernisation challenges and reduce legacy dependencies    Develop DevOps practices within Service Domains and help teams become independent in building, deploying and operating modernised applications    Ensure refactored applications meet Nordea Quality Standards, including security, maintainability and operational readinessThis role is open in Poland (Tri-city or Warsaw), Finland (Helsinki), Sweden (Stockholm), Denmark (Taastrup), or Norway (Oslo). We offer employment with various benefits based on your location, which may include private health and life insurance, learning opportunities, holiday subsidies, bonuses and more.Who you areYou are an experienced engineer who combines strong software development skills with curiosity, initiative and sound technical judgement. You see AI as an engineering tool, not a substitute for understanding the system or taking responsibility for the result. You are confident but humble, solution-driven and comfortable questioning generated code. You understand that software quality goes beyond code quality to include correct behaviour, security, reliable delivery and operability. You enjoy helping others adopt new tools and ways of working.This is the right role for you if you:    Have a solid system engineering and development background    Are comfortable reading unfamiliar legacy code and validating AI-generated changes against application requirements    Have practical experience moving legacy applications or code to modern cloud environments    Stay one step ahead by identifying technical risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities    Are comfortable switching between hands-on engineering, troubleshooting and stakeholder discussions    Can stand your ground when needed while remaining open to different perspectives    Communicate and pitch technical solutions clearly to Service Domain leads and engineering teams    Enjoy guiding and mentoring others through technical and organisational changeYour background and skills include:    Strong hands-on Java development experience, including Spring and Spring Boot, and the ability to understand and refactor legacy applications; familiarity with Node.js    Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, with the ability to critically review generated code and verify changes through unit, integration and regression testing    Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Git/Bitbucket and tools such as Tekton, Argo CD or Jenkins, together with infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible    Strong Linux and Windows system administration and troubleshooting skills, with experience operating systems in virtualised, cloud or containerised environments    A solid understanding of Google Cloud Platform and how to deploy, operate and modernise applications in a Google Cloud environment    Familiarity with container-based application architecture and infrastructure using Docker and KubernetesIt would be ideal if you also have:    Experience developing AI-assisted engineering frameworks or agentic workflows, including repository context grounding, constrained tool use, automated validation and human review to reduce hallucinations and unsupported changes     Experience with AWS    Knowledge of Groovy    Change management mindsetIf this sounds like you, get in touch!Next stepsSubmit your application no later than 02/12/2026. For more information about the position, you are more than welcome to contact recruiter Sanna Frisk at sanna.frisk@nordea.com.For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Software Developer - Mining Safety
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Do you want to build software that helps operators understand what is happening around them in demanding mining environments? Join Epiroc and work on solutions that bring together backend services, Android applications, and machine-connected technology. Join our teamYou will join our development team primarily based in Luleå. The team develops an OEM-independent solution for situational awareness and safety in mining, giving operators a graphical overview of the mine and their surroundings. The team’s work spans backend services, Android applications, and embedded software for physical tracking devices. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience. For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager, Petra Liljenroth, petra.liljenroth@epiroc.com Recruitment specialist, Otto Wetterström, otto.wetterstrom@external.epiroc.com Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.

title: Head Of Project Controls
description: Role overviewWe are looking for an experienced Head of Project Controls to lead Stegra’s Central Project Controls team on the Boden Project. The role sets the controls strategy, standards and governance for planning, cost, estimating, change, risk and reporting, and makes sure they are applied consistently across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant.The Head of Project Controls will be the senior controls voice to project leadership, giving an honest and integrated view of time and cost performance, and making sure emerging threats are visible early enough for leadership to act.Reporting line and team structureThe Central Project Controls team sets the standards, processes and governance for project controls and delivers into each of the project areas (Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant).Reports to the Chief Finance Officer, Stegra Boden Project. Leads the Central Project Controls team, including cost, planning, estimating, change and reporting, and sets the standards to which the Area Project Controls Managers work.Key responsibilities■      Lead the Central Project Controls team and set the controls strategy, organisation and resourcing plan for the project.■      Define and own the project controls procedures, standards, WBS and coding structures, and governance that apply across all project areas.■      Ensure central standards are applied consistently in every project area, so that cost, schedule, change and risk data can be integrated and compared across Green Steel, Green Iron and Balance of Plant.■      Own the integrated scope, cost and schedule baseline for the project, and the process for controlling it.■      Provide integrated cost and schedule performance, forecasts and risk exposure to project leadership, executives and the board, with clear messages and the decisions required.■      Lead the monthly project controls cycle and challenge forecasts, progress and performance data that are not credible or not supported by evidence.■      Oversee earned value management and progress measurement across the project areas and EPCM contractors.■      Set the direction for project controls systems and data, including Primavera P6, Contruent, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Power BI, working with Stegra’s systems and data architecture teams.■      Ensure estimating, change control and risk management are fully integrated with cost and schedule control.■      Set the project controls requirements for EPCM contractors and hold them to account for the quality and timeliness of their data.■      Support funding and investment decisions with robust cost, schedule and cash-flow forecasts.■      Build, mentor and develop the central team and the wider project controls community across the project.Required experience and skills■      Minimum 15 years’ project controls experience on major capital projects, including at least 5 years leading a multidisciplinary project controls function.■      Proven experience leading project controls in an EPCM or owner’s team environment on a major project or programme.■      Deep understanding of planning and scheduling, cost control, estimating, change control, risk management, earned value and reporting, and how they fit together.■      A track record of setting up project controls functions, procedures and governance, ideally on a greenfield project.■      Experience presenting to executives, boards, lenders or investors.■      Strong leadership and stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge senior leaders and contractors.■      Familiarity with Primavera P6, Contruent or similar cost management systems, and Power BI.■      Experience in steel, metals, heavy industrial, energy or process plant projects would be beneficial.■      Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. AACE, APM, PMI or equivalent professional accreditation would be advantageous.Key expectationsThe successful candidate will give Stegra one integrated and trusted view of project performance, built on consistent standards across every project area. title: Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer
description: Experienced in open pit mining? Take on broad technical responsibilities and help shape the future of mining at Björkdalsgruvan.Would you like to use your experience in open pit mining to influence both technical solutions and operational practices? As a Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan, Sweden, you’ll take on broad responsibilities covering mine design, mine planning, drilling, blasting and water management.You’ll join a lean organisation with short decision-making processes, working closely with production and seeing your recommendations put into practice. In this newly established role, you’ll share your expertise and contribute to both the existing open pit operation and the planning of a larger future open pit.This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with a broader perspective on mine development in an international environment where English is the working language.Purpose, Offer and Benefits    Work in a lean organisation with close collaboration and the opportunity to see your technical recommendations put into practice.    An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement are key priorities.    A flexible and rewarding work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.    Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.Your Responsibilities    Develop and optimise open pit mine design, mining sequences and short- and long-term production planning.    Plan bench development and mining sequences, contributing to the future development of Björkdal´s open pit operations.    Provide technical support for drilling and blasting, including design, quality control and performance monitoring.    Work with dewatering, drainage and water management to prepare new mining areas.    Monitor production performance and technical data, translating analysis into improvements in safety, productivity and cost efficiency.    Support production technicians through technical problem-solving, knowledge sharing and the development of operational practices.The Bigger PictureThis is a full-time, permanent position based at Björkdalsgruvan, near Skellefteå, Sweden. You will work regular daytime hours with flexible working arrangements based on trust and responsibility. The role is primarily site-based, with some flexibility depending on operational needs.This is a newly established position where you will work closely with a small team consisting of two production technicians and a supervisory function. Initially, you will report directly to the Mine Manager and collaborate with the mine´s other planning functions.Björkdal´s open pit operations are entering an exciting phase of development. The existing open pit has an expected remaining operational life of 3–4 years, while a potential expansion of the original Björkdal main open pit could extend operations by at least another 5–6 years. This offers you the opportunity to contribute to both ongoing production and technical challenges that will shape the mine´s long-term development.Our ExpectationsThe most important qualification is several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining operations. You may have worked as a Mining Engineer, Open Pit Engineer, Mine Planner or Drill and Blast Engineer.To succeed in this role, you will need:    Several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining.    A solid understanding of mine design, mine planning, drilling and blasting.    A degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.    Experience with mine planning and design software, along with the ability to learn new systems.    A valid Category B driving licence and good English communication skills.It would be an advantage if you have:    Swedish language skills.    Experience supporting and developing other technical team members.As a person, you are solution-oriented and confident in your technical judgement. You can identify challenges, develop practical solutions and clearly communicate your recommendations to colleagues with different areas of expertise. You are comfortable working independently while also valuing close collaboration with production and technical teams.Interested?The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with Talent Navigation Group (TNG), a recruitment and staffing company, and the technical recruitment specialists at TNG Tech. By taking a broader perspective on technical expertise, they identify more engineers, technicians and managers who match the needs of Swedish employers, both today and in the future.We look forward to receiving your application with your CV or LinkedIn profile. No cover letter is required.Please note that we do not accept applications via email, but you are always welcome to contact the recruiter by email if you have any questions.Once you have submitted your application, we will anonymise your personal information and invite you to complete a couple of recruitment assessments before conducting an initial objective evaluation. You will receive more information about each step as the process progresses, and you can track the status of your application in real time through our website.Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: HSE Specialist/Work Environment Engineer
description: The opportunityAt Hitachi Energy’s plant in Figeholm, we are looking for a Work Environment Engineer or HSE Specialist with an interest in fire protection, explosion risks, and chemical safety. In Figeholm, we manufacture cellulose-based insulation materials for the transformer industry. You will work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where safety considerations are closely linked to production, maintenance, chemical handling, and investment projects.The role has a clear specialist focus, but you do not need to be an expert in all areas from day one. We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in occupational health and safety, risk management, or a related field, and a desire to further develop expertise in fire safety, explosion protection, and chemical safety. You will be part of the plant’s Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) function. Together with managers, employees, and technical specialists, you will identify risks and develop solutions that both meet regulatory requirements and support day-to-day operations. The role combines hands-on and strategic work. You will spend time on the production floor, lead risk assessments, and contribute specialist expertise to projects, process improvements, and operational changes.How you’ll make an impact    Lead and support risk assessments related to occupational health and safety, fire protection, explosion risks, and chemical management.    Develop and strengthen the plant’s fire prevention and fire protection programs.    Support compliance and risk management activities related to flammable goods and explosive atmospheres (ATEX).    Support the safe handling, storage, and risk assessment of chemical products.    Translate legal requirements and Hitachi Energy’s HSE standards into practical procedures and ways of working.    Participate in incident investigations and follow up on corrective and preventive actions.    Provide HSE expertise in investment projects, engineering activities, and operational changes.    Conduct audits, inspections, and follow-up activities, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.Your background    Relevant university degree in occupational health and safety, safety engineering, fire protection, chemistry, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.    Experience in occupational health and safety, risk management, or industrial safety within a manufacturing or industrial environment.    Experience conducting and documenting risk assessments.    Ability to translate technical and regulatory requirements into practical solutions and operational improvements.    Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with production teams, technical specialists, and management.    You are confident in identifying risks and challenging existing ways of working when necessary. At the same time, you are solution-oriented and committed to developing improvements in close cooperation with the people who operate and support the business.    Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and relevant ISO standards.    Experience investigating and managing customer complaints, non-conformities, and quality-related issues.    Proven experience in root cause analysis and structured problem-solving methodologies.    Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma principles and continuous improvement practices.    Strong analytical skills combined with a structured and systematic approach to work.    Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.More about usWe believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already todayQuestions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Mikael Blomberg, mikael.blomberg@hitachienergy.com Union representatives - Pappers: Dennis Bäckman, +46 107-38 18 70; Unionen: Jens Lindbäck, +46 107 38 18 68

title: Operations Manager, Burckhardt Compression Sweden
description: Join Burckhardt Compression AB as Operations Manager. Burckhardt Compression is a global leader in reciprocating compression technology and services, we’re driven by innovation, precision, and purpose.  We’re now looking for a hands-on Operations Manager to join our team in Sweden. If you have technical experience with our product and industry, and you’re passionate about safety, operational excellence, and empowering teams to perform at their best - this is your opportunity to make a real impact. Your Mission As the Operations Manager, you’ll be the hub of our workshop and field service operations – supporting a high-performing team and ensuring that every process, project, and customer interaction reflects our commitment to quality, safety, and innovation. Here’s how you’ll contribute:     Champion Safety     Foster a zero-incident culture by leading safety initiatives and ensuring compliance with all health and safety standards.     Manage End-to-End Operations     Oversee all aspects of service operations - from field service and workshop activities to logistics, purchasing, machining and quality control. Ensure seamless execution from order to cash.     Provide Technical Guidance. Source and provide technical guidance and support to ensure high-quality service delivery and operational excellence.     Drive Quality and Compliance     Implement and uphold robust structures, policies, and procedures. Ensure full compliance with ISO9001, Burchardt Compression standards and all relevant legal frameworks.     Inspire and Develop Teams     Provide hands-on support and mentorship to drive performance and engagement.  Lead by example, support HR initiatives, and build a motivated, collaborative team culture.      Enhance Customer and Vendor Experience     Act as a key point of contact for customers and suppliers. Resolve issues promptly and promote a culture of listening to the “Voice of the Customer.”     Promote Innovation and Lean Thinking     Apply Lean principles and modern technologies to streamline operations, reduce costs and boost efficiency.     Support Financial Performance     Contribute to strategic revenue and EBIT growth. Provide cost estimations, manage budgets and ensure financial efficiency across operations.  What You Bring You’re not just a manager - you thrive in complex, fast-paced environments and bring clarity, structure and energy to everything you do. To succeed in this role, you’ll bring: You will bring 3+ years in operational management roles within reciprocating compressor industrial services, engineering or manufacturing and experience of leading diverse teams or driving strategic initiatives, balancing big-picture thinking with day-to-day execution:     Technical and Commercial Acumen     A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is great but we are open to equivalent practical experience. You understand how operations connect to financial performance and can manage budgets, costs and revenue targets with confidence.     Communication & Cross-Cultural Skills     You’re fluent in English, as our international business language, adaptable in your communication, and comfortable in international, multicultural teams. Additional Nordic languages are a plus.     Customer Orientation     You understand that great service is the foundation of long-term success.  You build strong relationships, listen actively and act quickly to resolve issues.      Operational Precision     You’re organized, detail-oriented and skilled at managing complex workflows across departments - from logistics and purchasing to field service and quality control.     Problem-Solving Mindset     You don’t just react - you anticipate. You’re analytical, decisive and always looking for smarter, more efficient ways to get things done.     Entrepreneurial Drive     You see opportunities where others see obstacles. You take initiative, embrace innovation, and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo to move the business forward.     Tech-Forward Thinking     You’re confident using modern tools and systems and see technology as a key enabler of operational excellence and continuous improvement.  What Success Looks Like Success in this role means more than just keeping operations running - it means leading with purpose, empowering your team and delivering measurable impact across the business. Here’s how you’ll know you’re making a difference:     Operational Excellence     You ensure smooth, timely, and high-quality execution across all service operations - from field service to logistics and quality control.     Customer Confidence     Customers trust your leadership. You resolve issues quickly, maintain strong relationships, and consistently deliver on expectations.     Team Empowerment     Your team is engaged, aligned, and high-performing. You lead by example, support development, and foster a culture of accountability and collaboration.     Efficiency and Innovation     You streamline workflows, reduce waste and implement smart, cost-effective solutions using lean principles and modern technologies.     Financial Impact     You contribute directly to revenue and EBIT growth by managing costs, improving margins and supporting strategic sales initiatives.     Safety Leadership     You uphold a zero-tolerance approach to safety violations and lead initiatives that create a proactive, safety-first culture.     Compliance and Quality     You ensure full compliance with internal standards and external regulations, with minimal audit findings and consistently high-quality outcomes.     Continuous Improvement     You don’t just maintain processes - you improve them. You identify opportunities, implement changes, and track their impact on performance.  Ready to Power the Future with Us? At Burckhardt Compression, we fuel progress. You’ll be part of a global team driving innovation, sustainability and service excellence, supporting industries that keep the world moving. We offer a collaborative international environment, opportunities for growth, and a competitive package that includes a globally benchmarked salary, annual bonus, pension, life assurance, and role-specific allowances. If you're ready to bring energy, ownership, and purpose to your next role apply now and help us deliver excellence, one operation at a time.

title: Developer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity: As a Software Developer in our organization, you will be part of a global team developing the software platforms and capabilities that power Ericsson's Purpose-built and Cloud RAN solutions. title: Senior Data Engineer | Microsoft Azure
description: SammanfattningVill du ta ett tekniskt helhetsansvar för moderna dataplattformar i Microsofts ekosystem? Hos Avanade får du som senior Data Engineer kombinera djup teknisk kompetens i Microsoft Fabric och Azure med rådgivning, arkitektur och genomförande i komplexa kunduppdrag.Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet av Data Engineering och som självständigt har designat, byggt och produktionssatt molnbaserade datalösningar. Rollen har ett stort fokus på Microsoft Fabric, och vi förväntar oss att du har praktisk erfarenhet av Fabric eller djup erfarenhet av närliggande delar av Microsofts dataplattform samt förmåga att snabbt omsätta den i Fabric-baserade lösningar.Du blir en senior del av vårt Data & AI-team och förväntas bidra med teknisk riktning, kvalitet och erfarenhet. Du arbetar nära andra Data Engineers, arkitekter och specialister, stöttar mer juniora kollegor och hjälper teamet att fatta hållbara teknikval utifrån både kundens mål och lösningens långsiktiga förvaltning.Om rollenSom Senior Data Engineer tar du ansvar från behovsanalys och teknisk design till implementation, produktionssättning och vidareutveckling av datalösningar i Microsoft Fabric och Azure. Du driver tekniska diskussioner, bryter ned komplexa krav och säkerställer att lösningen är skalbar, säker, kostnadseffektiv och möjlig att förvalta. Som konsult förväntas du snabbt förstå kundens verksamhet, skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter, ge tydliga rekommendationer och ta ansvar för att uppdraget går framåt även när förutsättningarna förändras.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterI rollen kommer du bland annat att:    Designa, bygga och produktionssätta skalbara dataplattformar i Microsoft Fabric och Azure    Ta tekniskt ansvar för datapipelines, integrationer, datalager och datamodeller.     Översätta verksamhetsbehov och icke-funktionella krav till hållbar arkitektur och genomförbara lösningar.     Sätta principer och arbetssätt för kodkvalitet, testning, observability, säkerhet och kostnadskontroll.     Utveckla avancerade transformationer och integrationer med SQL, Python, Spark, API:er och olika källsystem.     Etablera och förbättra versionshantering, kodgranskning, CI/CD och infrastructure as code.     Leda tekniska workshops, presentera vägval och ge rådgivning till kundens beslutsfattare och specialister.     Vara teknisk förebild, granska lösningar och coacha andra Data Engineers i kund- och leveransteam tvärfunktionella team. Bakgrund och erfarenhet:     Minst fem men gärna tio års relevant erfarenhet av Data Engineering och dokumenterad leverans av datalösningar i produktio.     Djup praktisk kompetens i SQL och Python samt erfarenhet av distribuerad databearbetning, exempelvis Spark.     Erfarenhet av att designa lösningar för ingestion, transformation, lagring, modellering, orkestrering och konsumtion av data.     Praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric eller djup erfarenhet av Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse och närliggande Azure-tjänster.     God förståelse för lakehouse- och datalagerarkitektur, prestanda, säkerhet, data governance och kostnadsoptimering.     Dokumenterad vana av Git, automatiserad testning, kodgranskning, CI/CD och strukturerad teknisk dokumentation.     Stark konsulterfarenhet: du kan självständigt leda kunddialoger, utmana krav konstruktivt, förankra tekniska beslut och hantera förväntningar     Förmåga att ta ägarskap för leverans, identifiera risker tidigt och skapa framdrift i miljöer med flera intressenter.     Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skriftMeriterande:    Djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric    Microsoft-certifieringar inom Fabric, Azure Data eller närliggande område.     Erfarenhet av Power BI och av att utforma datalager och modeller för analys och self-service.     Erfarenhet av större migreringar eller modernisering av data- och analysplattformar.     Infrastructure as code med exempelvis Terraform eller Bicep.     Microsoft Purview, avancerad data governance, DevOps, FinOps eller AI-baserade datalösningar.Du kommer sannolikt att lyckas i rollen om du:    Tar ett tydligt ägarskap och driver tekniska frågor från otydligt problem till fungerande leverans.     Kan växla mellan kod, arkitektur, rådgivning och dialog med verksamheten utan att tappa helhetsperspektivet.     Bygger förtroende genom att vara lyhörd, tydlig och transparent med risker, avvägningar och rekommendationer.     Vågar utmana kunden konstruktivt och kan förklara komplex teknik på ett sätt som möjliggör beslut.     Delar kunskap, höjer kvaliteten i teamet och skapar arbetsro även när uppdraget är komplext eller föränderligt. Some of the best things about working at Avanade:Opportunity to work for Microsoft’s Global Alliance Partner of the Year (14 years) As you bring your skills and abilities to Avanade, you’ll get distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return. As we continue to build our diverse and inclusive culture, we become even more innovative and creative, helping us better serve our clients and communities. You’ll join a community of smart, supportive collaborators to lift, mentor, and guide you, and to lean on your expertise. You get a company purpose-built for business-critical, leading-edge technology solutions, committed to improving the way humans work, interact, and live. It’s all here, so take a closer look! Together we do what matters.We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.Create a future for our people that focuses on    Expanding your thinking • Experimenting courageously • Learning and pivotingInspire greatness in our people by    Empowering every voice • Encouraging boldness • Celebrating progressAccelerate the impact of our people by    Amazing the client • Prioritizing what matters • Acting as one

title: Early Years Class Assistant, International School of Helsingborg
description: About usThe International School of Helsingborg has provided a truly international education at the Primary and Secondary levels since 1995. Today, we have approximately 650 students between 3 and 19 years of age, across all programmes. We are an IB Continuum school, delivering the International Baccalaureate curriculum for all program levels. English is the primary language of learning at the school.ISH prides itself on its diversity within and among all members of the learning community. Every member of our learning community brings something exciting and enriching to the school, which creates an inspiring environment. The aim of our school is to develop internationally minded people who, recognising their common humanity and shared guardianship of the planet, help to create a better and more peaceful world.Read more about the International School of Helsingborg on our website: https://internationalschool.helsingborg.se/Job descriptionAs an early years assistant, your role will be to organize and monitor activities for the students, ages 3-5 in the early years program. You will work with a team of early years teachers and will be expected to interact with the students in a caring manner. You will be expected to lead a group of students with positive behavior management techniques. You will be expected to work together in a team with the early years colleagues in order to plan engaging activities for the students. The hours vary on a daily basis approximately between 07:30 and 17:30 each day.The position includes supporting students and teachers in the regular classroom during the school day in addition to after-school activities. We are looking for someone who works well in a team. You are positive, open minded and flexible. When working with the students, you are consistent and kind. You take the time to get to know the students and build relationships with them. You take initiative within organizing activities and helping to make early years a place students enjoy.QualificationsA degree or certificate within early years and/or in primary education is preferred.The successful candidate will have at least two years’ experience working with groups of kids in the ages 3-5, including working with children with various support needs.The primary language of the school is English. Therefore, it is critical and required that any candidates are able to read, write and speak in English fluently.Priority will be given to candidates who are also fluent in Swedish.Other informationApply by:  December 7, 2026. We reserve the right to start the recruitment process earlier.Terms of employment:  Tidsbegränsad anställning (Temporary position)Scope:  100 %Date:  January 25, 2027 - June 25, 2027No of positions:  1 In the City of Helsingborg different is good. We want our employees to reflect our residents and we cherish the value that gender balance and diversity adds to our organisations.The vacancy will be filled assuming that the position is not required for an employee already on a permanent contract.If you are offered a position within pre-school,  school or in after-school care you must provide a valid Police Record Extract.To assure quality, the recruitment process in the City of Helsingborg, the recruitment tool ReachMee is used. We ask you to submit your application via ReachMee by clicking the application link in the advertisement.Applicants with protected identity should not apply digitally via the application link. They are asked to contact the recruiting manager named in the advertisement who will guide them through the application process. We have already considered the recruitment channels we wish to use for this vacancy.  Therefore, we kindly, but firmly, ask not to be contacted with regards to offers of supply services, advertising or recruitment.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description: Do you want to furnish the future with innovative products?With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. Every day, we strive to make our supply chain smarter, faster and more resilient.You will belong to the Supply Data & Analytics team, reporting to the Data & Analytics Manager. The hub starts with our Data Scientists, and the role may extend to include other software engineering roles as the team grows.Our Data & Analytics team works in a product operating model: cross-functional data product teams, guided by product leaders, own and continuously improve data products that create lasting value for IKEA Supply. The product teams own what is built and why; you own the people and the craft, making sure your team members are motivated, growing and set up to do great work in those teams. Your most important job is to be a great manager. You will also be a trusted technical guide for the team on methods, quality and good practice, and collaborate closely with product owners, Data & Digital Product Leaders and stakeholders across IKEA Supply.In this role, your typical week can look something like this:    Leading, coaching and developing your team members through regular one-to-ones, feedback, career conversations and clear expectations, creating a safe and inclusive team culture.    Taking care of recruitment, onboarding, competence development and succession planning for your competence hub.    Making sure your Data Scientists and other engineers are well placed in cross-functional data product teams, partnering with product owners on priorities and capacity, and removing blockers so the team can deliver value continuously.    Providing technical leadership for Data Scientists and other software engineering roles, supporting sound engineering, modelling, statistics, machine learning and experimentation practices, and making sure quality is built into every deliverable.    Making sure insights, solutions and conclusions from data science and software engineering are clear, trusted and easily available to business stakeholders, and that technical, statistical and machine learning concepts are explained to non-technical audiences.    Collaborating with data engineers, analysts, architects, software engineers and peers to ensure consistent methodologies, tools and ways of working across Supply Data & Analytics and the wider IKEA data and engineering community.    Supporting responsible use of AI and AI assisted tools in data science and software engineering work, and keeping up to date with technology trends and business needs.    Contributing to planning and budgeting by providing input on resources, development and investment needs.QualificationsWhat we'd like you to bring to the tableThe role as a Software Engineering Manager is a good match if you bring:    Direct or title: PhD Student - Microscopy and Microstructure Modelling 100 %
description: Help shape the future of green hydrogen! Combine advanced microscopy and 3D microstructure modelling in an international research team to develop more efficient and durable water electrolyzers.PhD Student \- Microscopy and Microstructure Modelling 100 %**What you will be responsible for*** You characterize the microstructure of porous layers, catalyst layers and interfaces using advanced microscopy techniques (SEM/EDX, FIB\-SEM, optical microscopy) and analyse X\-ray tomography data.* You develop and validate stochastic 3D microstructure models and digital twins of porous materials based on microscopy and fabrication data.* You generate virtual microstructures with systematically varied material and fabrication parameters to explore and optimize porous layer architectures.* You calculate effective transport properties using numerical simulation tools (primarily GeoDict), establish microstructure\-property relationships and compare results with experimental data.* You collaborate with experimental research partners in Switzerland and France to characterize newly developed materials, investigate degradation and derive recommendations for improved performance and durability.* You contribute microstructure data and simulation results to the project's multiscale modelling and machine\-learning activities, supporting data preparation, optimization strategies and interpretation of results.**What makes you a great fit*** You hold a Master's degree in materials science, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.* You have a strong interest in microscopy/image analysis, computational 3D microstructure modelling, multiphysics simulation and are motivated to develop your expertise in these complementary fields.* You have basic programming or scripting skills ( Python or MATLAB) and enjoy analysing scientific data and exploring relationships between material structures and properties.* You are curious about emerging AI\-based methods and motivated to explore their potential to advance image analysis, microstructure modelling and scientific data processing.* You communicate effectively in English and enjoy working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.Additional qualifications (nice to have)* Previous experience with microscopy, 3D image processing, numerical simulation or microstructure modelling is an advantage. Expertise in all these methods is not expected.* Familiarity with electrochemistry, PEM water electrolysis, corrosion or machine learning is welcome but not required.**About your workplace**The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in German\-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees.  We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances.**School of Engineering**The ZHAW School of Engineering (SoE) is one of Switzerland's leading education and research institutions, focusing on future\-oriented topics. With 10 Bachelor's degree programmes, one Master's degree programme, and a broad continuing education offering, it covers a wide range of qualifications. Fourteen institutes and centers ensure high\-quality education, research, and development with a focus on the areas of energy, mobility, information, and health.**The Institute of Computational Physics (ICP)**The Institute of Computational Physics (ICP) at ZHAW combines advanced image analysis, 3D microstructure modelling and multiphysics simulations with experimental characterization and data\-driven materials design. Our interdisciplinary team works closely with research and industry partners to advance electrochemical energy technologies.**Any questions? title: Primary School Teacher
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Primary School Teacher--- Primary School Teacher======================**Teaching Opportunities – Bilingual Primary School** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Switzerland** Wisdom Tree Education is an independent bilingual French–English primary school in Lausanne. As part of its ongoing development and the enrichment of its educational offering, the school wishes to meet experienced and committed educators to complement its existing teaching team. We welcome applications from generalist primary teachers and subject specialists, with a particular interest at present in physical education, science and language teaching. Different levels of involvement and teaching commitments may be considered, depending on the experience, interests and availability of candidates. **The school** Wisdom Tree is a small, family\-oriented school with an educational vision spanning the primary years, from ages 4 to 12\. Small class sizes allow for individual attention, differentiated teaching and close relationships between children, teachers and families. The early years (ages 4–6\) follow authentic Montessori pedagogy, with AMI\-trained educators. From the age of six, children transition progressively towards more structured academic learning, retaining the independence, curiosity and intellectual engagement developed during their Montessori years. Our curriculum is based on the Swiss Plan d’études romand (PER), enriched by elements of the English and French national curricula and complementary international educational approaches. Our pedagogical approach incorporates spiral learning, enabling children to revisit and deepen their understanding of key concepts, with individualised progression according to their abilities and needs. Elements of Montessori and Freinet pedagogy, including individual work plans, self\-correction and mastery\-based assessment, encourage autonomy and responsibility within a structured academic framework. Our bilingual programme aims to develop genuine fluency and academic competence in both French and English. We place considerable importance on academic excellence, alongside the emotional, social, physical and personal development of each child. The school has a spiritually open, non\-denominational ethos, welcoming families of all backgrounds and encouraging respect, reflection and a sense of meaning. Located in a residential area of Lausanne, the school benefits from a private garden, an outdoor play area and nearby green spaces. Nature, outdoor activities and experiential learning form an important part of our educational approach. **Teaching and educational opportunities** We are interested in meeting educators who enjoy working within a small, collaborative school environment and who wish to contribute their own expertise and ideas. Alongside classroom teaching, there are opportunities to participate in curriculum development, interdisciplinary projects, enrichment activities and outdoor education. We particularly value teachers who are comfortable working with small, mixed\-ability groups and who can combine clear, structured teaching with an understanding of individual learning needs. Depending on experience and interests, opportunities to contribute more broadly to the pedagogical and organisational development of the school may also be considered. **Candidate profile** Candidates should ideally possess: * Recognised teaching qualifications or relevant specialist qualifications.* Experience working with primary\-aged children.* Strong subject knowledge and sound pedagogical skills.* The ability to establish a structured, positive and respectful classroom environment.* High academic expectations combined with patience, warmth and kindness.* A collaborative and practical approach to working with colleagues and families. A strong command of French and/or English is required, depending on the teaching area. Bilingualism is particularly valued. Experience in Montessori, international education, differentiated teaching or curriculum development would be an advantage, but is not essential for all positions. **Working at Wisdom Tree** The school’s size allows teachers to know their pupils well, adapt their teaching and follow each child’s progress closely. Educators have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the curriculum and teaching practices, working alongside colleagues and the founders in an environment that values professional expertise, initiative and constructive dialogue. We welcome applications from educators seeking an immediate teaching opportunity, a part\-time commitment or a longer\-term collaboration. **Applications** Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience, educational approach, areas of expertise and availability. **Opportunités d’enseignement – École primaire bilingue** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Suisse** Wisdom Tree Education est une école primaire bilingue français–anglais indépendante située à Lausanne. Dans le cadre de son développement et de l’enrichissement de son offre pédagogique, l’école souhaite rencontrer des professionnels de l’enseignement expérimentés et engagés afin de compléter son équipe actuelle. Nous accueillons les candidatures d’enseignants généralistes du primaire et de spécialistes de différentes disciplines, avec un intérêt particulier actuellement pour l’éducation physique et sportive, les sciences et l’enseignement des langues. Différents taux d’activité et modalités de collaboration peuvent être envisagés selon l’expérience, les aspirations et les disponibilités des candidats. **L’école** Wisdom Tree est une école à taille humaine, à caractère familial, dont le projet pédagogique couvre les années du primaire, de 4 à 12 ans. Les classes à petits effectifs permettent un accompagnement individualisé, une différenciation des apprentissages et des relations de proximité entre les enfants, les enseignants et les familles. Pour les enfants de 4 à 6 ans, l’enseignement repose sur la pédagogie Montessori, avec des professionnels formés à l’AMI. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants évoluent progressivement vers des apprentissages académiques plus structurés, tout en préservant l’autonomie, la curiosité et l’engagement intellectuel développés durant leurs premières années Montessori. Notre programme s’appuie sur le Plan d’études romand (PER), enrichi d’éléments des programmes scolaires anglais et français ainsi que d’approches pédagogiques internationales complémentaires. Notre démarche pédagogique intègre un apprentissage en spirale, permettant aux enfants de revisiter et d’approfondir régulièrement les notions essentielles, avec une progression individualisée selon leurs acquis et leurs besoins. Des éléments des pédagogies Montessori et Freinet, notamment les plans de travail individuels, l’autocorrection et les brevets de maîtrise, favorisent l’autonomie et la responsabilisation dans un cadre académique structuré. Nous accordons une grande importance à l’excellence académique, ainsi qu’au développement affectif, social, physique et personnel de chaque enfant. L’école s’inscrit dans une démarche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant les familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et la recherche de sens. Située dans un quartier résidentiel de Lausanne, l’école bénéficie d’un jardin privé, d’un espace de jeux extérieur et d’espaces verts à proximité. La nature, les activités en plein air et l’apprentissage par l’expérience occupent une place importante dans notre démarche éducative. **Opportunités d’enseignement et de collaboration** Nous souhaitons rencontrer des professionnels qui apprécient le travail au sein d’une équipe pédagogique à taille humaine et qui souhaitent y apporter leur expertise et leurs idées. Nous apprécions particulièrement les enseignants à l’aise avec des groupes à petits effectifs et de niveaux différents, capables d’associer un enseignement clair et structuré à une prise en compte des besoins individuels des enfants. title: Primary School Teacher
description: ---base:  meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width,  title: Primary School Teacher--- Primary School Teacher======================**Teaching Opportunities – Bilingual Primary School** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Switzerland** Wisdom Tree Education is an independent bilingual French–English primary school in Lausanne. As part of its ongoing development and the enrichment of its educational offering, the school wishes to meet experienced and committed educators to complement its existing teaching team. We welcome applications from generalist primary teachers and subject specialists, with a particular interest at present in physical education, science and language teaching. Different levels of involvement and teaching commitments may be considered, depending on the experience, interests and availability of candidates. **The school** Wisdom Tree is a small, family\-oriented school with an educational vision spanning the primary years, from ages 4 to 12\. Small class sizes allow for individual attention, differentiated teaching and close relationships between children, teachers and families. The early years (ages 4–6\) follow authentic Montessori pedagogy, with AMI\-trained educators. From the age of six, children transition progressively towards more structured academic learning, retaining the independence, curiosity and intellectual engagement developed during their Montessori years. Our curriculum is based on the Swiss Plan d’études romand (PER), enriched by elements of the English and French national curricula and complementary international educational approaches. Our pedagogical approach incorporates spiral learning, enabling children to revisit and deepen their understanding of key concepts, with individualised progression according to their abilities and needs. Elements of Montessori and Freinet pedagogy, including individual work plans, self\-correction and mastery\-based assessment, encourage autonomy and responsibility within a structured academic framework. Our bilingual programme aims to develop genuine fluency and academic competence in both French and English. We place considerable importance on academic excellence, alongside the emotional, social, physical and personal development of each child. The school has a spiritually open, non\-denominational ethos, welcoming families of all backgrounds and encouraging respect, reflection and a sense of meaning. Located in a residential area of Lausanne, the school benefits from a private garden, an outdoor play area and nearby green spaces. Nature, outdoor activities and experiential learning form an important part of our educational approach. **Teaching and educational opportunities** We are interested in meeting educators who enjoy working within a small, collaborative school environment and who wish to contribute their own expertise and ideas. Alongside classroom teaching, there are opportunities to participate in curriculum development, interdisciplinary projects, enrichment activities and outdoor education. We particularly value teachers who are comfortable working with small, mixed\-ability groups and who can combine clear, structured teaching with an understanding of individual learning needs. Depending on experience and interests, opportunities to contribute more broadly to the pedagogical and organisational development of the school may also be considered. **Candidate profile** Candidates should ideally possess: * Recognised teaching qualifications or relevant specialist qualifications.* Experience working with primary\-aged children.* Strong subject knowledge and sound pedagogical skills.* The ability to establish a structured, positive and respectful classroom environment.* High academic expectations combined with patience, warmth and kindness.* A collaborative and practical approach to working with colleagues and families. A strong command of French and/or English is required, depending on the teaching area. Bilingualism is particularly valued. Experience in Montessori, international education, differentiated teaching or curriculum development would be an advantage, but is not essential for all positions. **Working at Wisdom Tree** The school’s size allows teachers to know their pupils well, adapt their teaching and follow each child’s progress closely. Educators have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the curriculum and teaching practices, working alongside colleagues and the founders in an environment that values professional expertise, initiative and constructive dialogue. We welcome applications from educators seeking an immediate teaching opportunity, a part\-time commitment or a longer\-term collaboration. **Applications** Please send your CV and a short covering letter outlining your experience, educational approach, areas of expertise and availability. **Opportunités d’enseignement – École primaire bilingue** **Wisdom Tree Education \| Lausanne, Suisse** Wisdom Tree Education est une école primaire bilingue français–anglais indépendante située à Lausanne. Dans le cadre de son développement et de l’enrichissement de son offre pédagogique, l’école souhaite rencontrer des professionnels de l’enseignement expérimentés et engagés afin de compléter son équipe actuelle. Nous accueillons les candidatures d’enseignants généralistes du primaire et de spécialistes de différentes disciplines, avec un intérêt particulier actuellement pour l’éducation physique et sportive, les sciences et l’enseignement des langues. Différents taux d’activité et modalités de collaboration peuvent être envisagés selon l’expérience, les aspirations et les disponibilités des candidats. **L’école** Wisdom Tree est une école à taille humaine, à caractère familial, dont le projet pédagogique couvre les années du primaire, de 4 à 12 ans. Les classes à petits effectifs permettent un accompagnement individualisé, une différenciation des apprentissages et des relations de proximité entre les enfants, les enseignants et les familles. Pour les enfants de 4 à 6 ans, l’enseignement repose sur la pédagogie Montessori, avec des professionnels formés à l’AMI. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants évoluent progressivement vers des apprentissages académiques plus structurés, tout en préservant l’autonomie, la curiosité et l’engagement intellectuel développés durant leurs premières années Montessori. Notre programme s’appuie sur le Plan d’études romand (PER), enrichi d’éléments des programmes scolaires anglais et français ainsi que d’approches pédagogiques internationales complémentaires. Notre démarche pédagogique intègre un apprentissage en spirale, permettant aux enfants de revisiter et d’approfondir régulièrement les notions essentielles, avec une progression individualisée selon leurs acquis et leurs besoins. Des éléments des pédagogies Montessori et Freinet, notamment les plans de travail individuels, l’autocorrection et les brevets de maîtrise, favorisent l’autonomie et la responsabilisation dans un cadre académique structuré. Notre programme bilingue vise à développer une véritable maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant sur le plan linguistique qu’académique. Nous accordons une grande importance à l’excellence académique, ainsi qu’au développement affectif, social, physique et personnel de chaque enfant. L’école s’inscrit dans une démarche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant les familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et la recherche de sens. Située dans un quartier résidentiel de Lausanne, l’école bénéficie d’un jardin privé, d’un espace de jeux extérieur et d’espaces verts à proximité. La nature, les activités en plein air et l’apprentissage par l’expérience occupent une place importante dans notre démarche éducative. **Opportunités d’enseignement et de collaboration** Nous souhaitons rencontrer des professionnels qui apprécient le travail au sein d’une équipe pédagogique à taille humaine et qui souhaitent y apporter leur expertise et leurs idées. Au\-delà de l’enseignement en classe, différentes possibilités de participation au développement des programmes, à des projets interdisciplinaires, à des activités d’enrichissement et à l’enseignement en plein air peuvent être envisagées. Nous apprécions particulièrement les enseignants à l’aise avec des groupes à petits effectifs et de niveaux différents, capables d’associer un enseignement clair et structuré à une prise en compte des besoins individuels des enfants. Selon l’expérience et les aspirations des candidats, une participation plus large au développement pédagogique et organisationnel de l’école pourra également être envisagée. **Profil recherché** Les candidats disposeront idéalement : * De qualifications reconnues dans l’enseignement ou dans leur domaine de spécialisation.* D’une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire.* De solides connaissances disciplinaires et compétences pédagogiques.* De la capacité à instaurer un cadre de classe structuré, positif et respectueux.* D’exigences académiques élevées, associées à la patience et à la bienveillance.* D’un esprit collaboratif et d’une approche pragmatique dans les relations avec les collègues et les familles. Une très bonne maîtrise du français et/ou de l’anglais est requise, selon le domaine d’enseignement. Le bilinguisme constitue un atout particulièrement apprécié. Une expérience en pédagogie Montessori, dans l’enseignement international, la différenciation pédagogique ou le développement de programmes scolaires serait un avantage, sans être indispensable pour tous les postes. **Travailler à Wisdom Tree** La taille de l’école permet aux enseignants de bien connaître leurs élèves, d’adapter leur enseignement et de suivre attentivement la progression d

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1148jm jiy26jm
