description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Thailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)---Thailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)================================================nach VereinbarungThailändischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (w/m/i)================================================nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:    Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Corporate Culinary Director* das Kreieren von neuen thailändischen Gerichten und Spezialitäten* die Zubereitung der thailändischen Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken aus Thailand* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter Koch mit langjähriger Erfahrung sowie umfangreichem Fachwissen über die thailändische Spezialitätenküche sowie den fundierten thailändischen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. title: Global Water Technologies Lead
description: The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us onGlobal Water Technologies Lead**Location:** Vevey, Switzerland  **Work model**: Hybrid / Full time  **Contract type / duration:** Permanent  **Target start date**: January 1, 2027  **Deadline for applications**: December 4, 2026**Be a force for good and inspire high\-performing Operations teams**As a **Global Water Technologies Lead at Global Operations**, your mission is to lead technical expertise in water and wastewater treatment and to guide a worldwide network of water experts, so our factories run safe, efficient and sustainable water systems. We are a global community of 150K\+ colleagues across the value chain \-Manufacturing \& Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement and Agriculture\- driving focus, speed and meaningful impact for consumers. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory engineering teams, regional and market technical leaders, sustainability champions, procurement teams, suppliers, universities and research institutes. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Floor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)---Floor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)=============================ab sofort oder nach VereinbarungFloor Supervisor 100% (w/m/i)=============================ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Diese Aufgabe umfasst die Gewährleistung der Sauberkeit und Werterhaltung im ganzen , die Kontrolle der sowie der öffentlichen Räume und die Koordination aller anfallenden Arbeiten im Housekeeping. Sie sind zuständig für die Einweisung der Mitarbeitenden, Sie unterstützen durch laufende Schulungen und stellen somit die Gästezufriedenheit her.    Sie haben die Ausbildung zur Hotelfachfrau EFZ oder Fachfrau Hauswirtschaft erfolgreich abgeschlossen, sprechen Deutsch, sind dienstleistungsorientiert und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig und effizient. Sie zeigen hohes Bewusstsein für Sauberkeit und Ordnung, sind zuverlässig und arbeiten gerne im Team. Wenn Sie ausserdem noch den Berufsbildnerkurs besucht haben und Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position mitbringen, so ist dies von Vorteil. Wir erwarten ein gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten. Fremdsprachen sind ein zusätzliches Plus im Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Gästen.    Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen    Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»   Handelszeitung«Bester Arbeitgeber  im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle  «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»       **BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG**  Alvarino  HR Business Partner  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid5efa204jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

title: COMMIS DE CUISINE
description: Tu veux apprendre la vraie cuisine italienne dans une brigade structurée ? Ici, on progresse pas à pas. TON RÔLE Tu soutiens le chef de partie et la brigade dans les préparations du quotidien, avec ordre, propreté et respect des procédures Luigia. Préparer la mise en place et garder ton poste en ordre. Étiqueter, dater et stocker correctement les produits. Soutenir la ligne pendant le service, y compris fritures et desserts. Appliquer chaque jour les règles HACCP et la chaîne du chaud et du froid. CE QUE NOUS T'OFFRONS CDI avec 13e salaire. 5 jours de travail et 2 jours de repos par semaine, 5 semaines de vacances payées par an. 50 % de réduction à l'emporter et 20 % sur place dans tous les restaurants Luigia. Remboursement de 50 % de l'abonnement annuel de transports publics et de 30 % pour l'achat d'un vélo ou d'une trottinette. Bonus mensuels et primes pour les grands moments : mariage, naissance d'un enfant, 10 ans chez Luigia. Cours de français ou d'allemand entièrement pris en charge par Luigia. Une formation aux produits et aux standards Luigia, et une vraie évolution interne. Un soutien à la relocation : démarches administratives et aide à la recherche de logement. TON PROFIL Une première expérience en cuisine, ou une vraie envie d'apprendre. Sérieux, précision et rigueur sur l'hygiène. Bonne dextérité et capacité à suivre le rythme. Esprit d'équipe. COMMENT ÇA SE PASSE Envoie ton CV: opportunity@luigia.ch . Quelques lignes sur toi suffisent. 3 jours d'essai rémunérés pour découvrir l'univers Luigia. QUI EST LUIGIA ? Luigia est née à Genève en 2010 avec une mission : apporter le meilleur de l'Italie au monde. Aujourd'hui, le groupe compte 11 restaurants en Suisse et un restaurant en franchise à Dubaï. Nous cuisinons comme nos grands-mères nous l'ont appris, avec des produits authentiques, en ajoutant seulement les techniques qui n'existaient pas à leur époque et qui nous permettent de tout valoriser sans rien gaspiller. Luigia est certifiée B Corp, a obtenu 3 Spicchi du Gambero Rosso et figure au classement 50 Top Pizza. Nous étudions chaque candidature sans distinction de genre, d'âge, d'origine ou de parcours. On t'attend !

title: Analyst
description: Millennium Management is a global hedge fund with more than 6,000 employees and offices in the United States, Europe and Asia.  We were founded in 1989, and we employ a global multi-strategy investment approach, opportunistically engaging in a broad array of trading and investing strategies. Millennium has differentiated itself from other investment management firms through our consistent ability over the last 35 years to generate returns that have not been correlated to the general market.The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. We offer an opportunity for developing one’s professional career while working with individuals trained in a variety of disciplines in a collegial and dynamic environment. We also offer a broad range of competitive benefits on a global basis. General Information- Hiring Department/Group:    Equities- Role:                                     Analyst- Office Location:                    Zug (CH)Job Function Summary:The successful candidate will support the Equities Volatility business through researching, developing, maintaining and monitoring option pricing and volatility models. They will partner closely with traders, quants, and technology teams to design the models used to price and risk-manage the book, deliver them into the team’s proprietary front-to-back trading platform, and keep them running during market hours, investigating and fixing issues in real time. The role requires strong analytical and modelling skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to move ideas from research to production in a fast-paced trading environment.Principal Responsibilities- Develop and maintain the team’s option pricing and volatility surface models. - Build analytics and front-end tools that support the traders’ decision-making.- Deliver risk, scenario and PnL explain views for the book, and support traders on day-to-day pricing and risk questions.- Contribute to the pricing and execution logic behind automated quoting and hedging.- Monitor pricing, risk and trading services during market hours, and debug and resolve production issues as they occur.- Take over a significant inherited codebase: understand it, keep it running in production, debug it and progressively improve it.- Own robust services and data pipelines, running in a real-time trading environment.Qualifications/Skills Required:- Master’s degree in applied mathematics (with specialism in probability and finance), physics or engineering from a university or equivalent institution.- Minimum of 2–4 years’ experience in an investment bank, including experience in derivatives, in a hybrid role covering quantitative research and quantitative development, to be able to demonstrate building trading models and shipping them as production code.- Strong understanding of derivatives pricing, stochastic calculus, numerical methods and volatility modelling.- Proficiency in Git and Linux required, and experience using Python C++. - Demonstrated experience of delivering production code used by traders and working in a large existing codebase.- Experience working in a fast-paced trading environment and demonstrated experience being able to prioritise under time pressure, take ownership and deliver robust solutions quickly.- Professional fluency in English required to be able to explain models clearly to traders and act on their feedback.

title: Advocacy officer – AMERICAS
description: Position summary : The Advocacy Officer (AO) supports and implements advocacy strategies related to the Americas region (50%) and provides general support to activities led by the International Advocacy Director (30%): Within the Americas program, the Advocacy Officer works with partner organizations and networks – particularly members of the Franciscan Family – at the country, regional, and international levels to coordinate and implement a regional advocacy strategy and related activities. The AO identifies key human rights issues within the region and opportunities to address these at the United Nations (UN). The AO also gathers and processes relevant information and facts related to the region.  The AO provides general support to the implementation of advocacy strategies and activities led by the International Advocacy Director.  The AO acts under the supervision of, and in cooperation with, the IAD and operates in compliance with FI’s vision and mission. About Franciscans International :Franciscans International is an international non-governmental organization, with general consultative status at the United Nations, working for the promotion and protection of human rights. Since its establishment in 1989, FI has used advocacy as a tool to address human rights abuses. From its offices in Geneva and New York, FI relies on the expertise and first-hand information of a large network of partners. We work together with and on behalf of Franciscan orders and congregations, as well as with grassroots movements and other civil society organizations to advocate for structural changes addressing the root causes of injustice.  MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES :Planning, management and monitoring results : Under the supervision of the IAD, implement FI’s advocacy strategy and related activities in the Americas region.  Coordination and networking : Coordinate with local partners on advocacy activities through facilitation of meetings, technical support, and mobilization. Participate in relevant regional meetings as needed. Ensure consultation of key constituencies to support FI’s work in specific countries and at the international level. Maintain and develop strategic contacts with Franciscans, non-governmental organizations (NGOs), UN agencies, diplomats, and other relevant partners. UN advocacy work : Address regional and/or country-specific concerns at UN level. Actively participate in relevant UN meetings and debates. Organize and coordinate advocacy work at the UN, including lobby meetings, awareness-raising events, and statements. Invite, organize, assist, and accompany local partners to take part in this work. Maintain and deepen networks and coalitions at international level for joint advocacy purposes.  UN reporting and research : Gather information through communication and coordination with partners. Draft and edit reports, briefings, and other advocacy and awareness-raising materials. Monitor and/or analyze developments concerning human rights issues relevant to FI’s advocacy strategy in the region. Translate information received from national partners into recommendations to UN human rights mechanisms. Capacity building : Implement capacity building activities and training programs for national partners on human rights advocacy. Coordinate and organize workshops and consultations with partners and other stakeholders in the region. Supervision : Assist in the supervision of consultants, provide oversight, and take responsibility for delegated assignments. Coordination with colleagues : Work with fundraising, project management, finance and communications team members. Perform all necessary administrative tasks.  Support to IAD : Assist with reporting on FI advocacy activities. Research and draft advocacy documents. Any other activities, including administrative tasks, required to assist the IAD in the implementation of FI’s overall advocacy strategy. CANDIDATE PROFILE Experience and qualifications :Advanced degree in law, international human rights law, international relations, development, or a related field. 1-3 years of relevant international human rights experience. Familiarity with UN human rights mechanisms, in particular the Human Rights Council and Treaty Bodies, is strongly desired. Experience working with NGOs is considered an asset.  Solid knowledge of the international human rights system, law, and policies. A sound understanding of the political context in which human rights advocacy processes take place.  Familiarity with human rights dynamics and trends in the Americas region, including related to human mobility.  Previous experience working with partners or organizations at the grassroots level is considered an asset. Skills and other requirements :Ability to effectively engage – including publicly – a wide range of audiences (diplomats, UN experts, affected communities, Franciscans, faith-leaders, and human rights defenders). Attention to detail and a strong commitment to achieving expected results. Ability to prioritize assignments and implement advocacy, fact-finding and capacity-building activities as well as monitor their impact. Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills. The ability to work in a diverse team, support colleagues, and work with minimal supervision at times. Proficiency in oral and written English and Spanish is essential. Knowledge of other relevant regional languages, especially Portuguese, is considered as a strong asset. Availability to travel if needed, including to the Americas region.  Strong commitment to human rights, social issues, and environmental justice. FI OFFERS Experience in a professional human rights advocacy organization, with strong connections at the grassroots; and  The ability to grow and develop in a junior position; A weekly working time of 32 hours (80%), 20 days of annual leave, travel insurance, and a salary commensurate with experience.  Location :    Geneva, Switzerland  Reports to : International Advocacy Director (IAD) Contract : 80%, permanent position Start date : 1 February 2027, depending on availability   HOW TO APPLY Deadline for application: 25 December 2026 Applications should be sent in English by email to Mr. Budi Tjahjono at b.tjahjono@franciscansinternational.org specifying “Advocacy Officer” in the subject line.  Applications should include the following documents:  A Curriculum Vitae;  A 1-page letter of motivation;  2 references with contact details – email, phone number, and relation; and  Confirmation that you have a valid Swiss work permit or are eligible to obtain one. Please note that, due to the holiday period, shortlisted candidates will be contacted by 6 January 2027. First-round interviews will be conducted between 11 and 15 January 2027. The successful candidate should start on 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible, depending on availability.  Franciscans International is an equal opportunity employer. All interested candidates matching the requirements are welcome to apply whatever their origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, or belief. We thank all those who apply. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We apologize that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Der elPadel Social Club ist eine schweizweit einzigartige Padel\-Location. Indoor\-Golf, Shuffleboard, die Sportsbar und ein Café runden unser Angebot ab. Wir bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Events aller – mit vielseitigen Möglichkeiten für kreative Ideen und unvergessliche Erlebnisse.**Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herzstück unseres Social Clubs. Jetzt brauchen wir Verstärkung: Wir suchen eine offene, empathische Persönlichkeit, die gerne im Team arbeitet, Sport liebt und gemeinsam mit uns etwas bewegen möchte. Du fühlst dich angesprochen? Dann lies unbedingt weiter!**### **Deine Aufgaben****Gastronomie \& Events*** Du führst unser Service\- und Küchenteam, bist im Alltag die erste Ansprechperson und erstellst die Schichtplanung.* Du gestaltest mit der Küche die Speise\- und Getränkekarte, kalkulierst die Preise und kümmerst dich um Warenmanagement und Einkauf.* Du stellst die Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften sicher und kümmerst dich um die Selbstkontrolle sowie die Vorbereitung und Begleitung behördlicher Kontrollen.* Du berätst Kund:innen und unterstützt sie bei der Planung und Durchführung ihrer Events.* Du bringst eigene Ideen in die Entwicklung unserer Events ein.* Neben \-Office\-Zeiten arbeitest du aktiv an der Front mit.**Club\- und Sportbetrieb*** Du sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste bei Padel, Indoor\-Golf und Shuffleboard bestens betreut fühlen und gerne wiederkommen.* Du hast ein für Sport und schaust, dass auf unseren Screens in der Sportsbar die richtigen Spiele laufen.**Das bringst du mit*** Du hast eine kaufmännische Aus\- oder Weiterbildung im Gastronomie\- oder Eventmanagement oder einen Hotelfachschule\-Abschluss. Diplome sind aber nicht alles: Bringst du fundierte Praxiserfahrung in diesen Bereichen mit, passt das für uns genauso.* Du bewegst dich mühelos in der digitalen Welt, arbeitest gerne mit IT\-Systemen und Office\-Programmen und hast Freude daran, dich in neue digitale Prozesse hineinzudenken.* Du begeisterst dich für Kulinarik und legst grossen Wert auf einen herzlichen, professionellen Kund:innenservice.* Du denkst unternehmerisch, gehst strukturiert vor und entwickelst gerne Konzepte, die du von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitest.* Du führst mit Energie und Weitblick: Du verwaltest nicht einfach, sondern packst an, gehst voran und willst gemeinsam mit uns wachsen und dein Team weiterbringen.* Du bist verlässlich und behältst auch dann einen kühlen , wenn es hektisch wird.* Du bringst eine sportliche, dynamische und offene Persönlichkeit mit und begeisterst andere mit deiner positiven .**Das bieten wir*** Eine vielseitige Leitungsfunktion mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen landen nicht in der Schublade, sondern auf der ükarte und im Betrieb.* Ein junges, motiviertes Team in einem Betrieb, der wächst und erst am Anfang steht.* Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungsprozesse und ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld* Attraktive Benefits wie kostenloses Padel spielen und diverse Vergünstigungen* Faire und attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und eine gute Pensionskasse**Bereit für den nächsten Aufschlag?**Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Foto und ein paar Zeilen, warum du zu uns passt, an jobs(at) .Fragen? , Geschäftsführer, ist gerne für dich da: .![elPadel AG]()* elPadel AG  Hofackerstrasse 13  8409 Winterthur*jid3cf747ajm jit1148jm jiy26jm

title: Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100%
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)---Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach VereinbarungPersischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Küchenchef* die Zubereitung der Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter und berufserfahrener Koch mit fundiertem Fachwissen über die persischen Spezialitätenküche sowie umfangreichen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen:  Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  Human Resources Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid15365bfjm jit1148jm jiy26jm

title: Legal Advisor - Commodities Trade Finance + Wealth Management
description: Description de l'entreprise**Client:** Our client is an established Swiss financial institution with an international client base and activities spanning Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Treasury. The Bank is looking for a pragmatic, commercially\-minded Legal Advisor to join its Legal \& Compliance function and provide hands\-on legal support across the business. Collegial and dynamic working environment within a stable bank. A Client that Finders know well, thus able to explain the culture and working environment to any potentially, suitable applicant.Description du poste**Position:**Reporting to the Head of Legal \& Compliance, you will provide day\-to\-day legal advice across the Bank, helping the business navigate legal and regulatory matters while taking a practical and solutions\-focused approach. title: Dessinateur ou Dessinatrice en Génie Civil / Modeleur-euse BIM 80-100%
description: Ref 2590591 \| Date: 11 Nov 2026![Groupe E SA]( ).Dessinateur ou Dessinatrice en Génie Civil / Modeleur\-euse BIM 80\-100%Actif\-ve\-s en Suisse occidentale, nous aidons nos client\-e\-s à réaliser leurs projets en fournissant des solutions énergétiques globales, efficaces et durables, qu'il s'agisse de production et de distribution d'électricité et de chaleur, d'installations électriques, de domotique, de mobilité douce, de climatisation ou de traitement de l'eau. Employeur exemplaire, nous soutenons le développement des compétences de nos 2450 collaborateurs\-trice\-s, dont 245 apprenti\-e\-s, ainsi que la conciliation entre vie privée et professionnelle.La **Direction Solutions énergies** développe des offres globales alliant conseil, conception, exécution, maintenance et exploitation. Elle est également le point d'entrée unique pour les grands projets, l'efficience et l'automation énergétiques, l'ingénierie électrique, le facility management et l'innovation.**Mission :*** Modéliser des maquettes 3D selon la méthodologie BIM pour des projets d'infrastructure énergétiques (postes et fondations lignes hautes tension, centrales de production, ect.),* Élaborer les plans techniques de structures et de génie civil notamment les plans de coffrages, d'armatures, de construction métallique, de terrassement et de canalisation pour toute type de projets, ainsi que les plans d'architecture pour les besoins d'enquête et d'exécution ;* Produire et adapter les plans et documents techniques aux différentes phases des projets, des études de faisabilités jusqu'à la réalisations (phases SIA 21 à 53\) ;* Collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs et responsables de projets afin de développer et traduire les solutions techniques en plans et modèles adaptés ;* Extraire les métrés, quantités et listes de matériaux à partir des maquettes numériques, tout en garantissant la qualité et la cohérence des documents produits ;* Participer au relevés et visites sur site, ainsi qu'à l'évolution des méthodes de travail et au développement de la méthodologie du BIM au sein de l'unité Génie civil.**Profil :*** Titulaire d'un CFC de dessinateur\-trice en génie civil ou d'une formation jugée équivalente ;* Expérience dans le domaine du génie civil, idéalement dans les structures en béton armée et métalliques, avec des connaissances en terrassement et en canalisation constituant un atout ;* Bonne maîtrise de Revit Structure et d'AutoCAD, ou facilité à apprendre de nouveaux logiciels, La connaissance de Civil 3D et/ou Advance Steel constitue un atout ;* Connaissance de la méthodologie BIM et un intérêt marqué pour les outils numériques ;* Rigoureux\-se et précis\-e, vous faites preuve d'un bon sens technique et êtes capable de proposer des solutions constructives adaptées ;* Autonome et organisé\-e, vous appréciez la diversité des projets, la collaboration avec les ingénieurs et le travail en équipe.**Ce que nous vous offrons :*** Un environnement évolutif et favorable à l'équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et privée.* Les prestations sociales d'une entreprise moderne, une équité de traitement, des possibilités de développement professionnel.* Un fort esprit de cohésion et une équipe fière de collaborer : « Ensemble, nous avançons vers la réussite ».**Besoin de renseignements complémentaires ?**  Contactez Yannick Jeckelmann, Responsable Ingénierie génie civil \- environnement au**Ressources Humaines**Brice Mullerjpid6176f37jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

using numerical simulation tools (primarily GeoDict), establish microstructure\-property relationships and compare results with experimental data.* You collaborate with experimental research partners simulation results to the project's multiscale modelling and machine\-learning activities, supporting data preparation, optimization strategies and interpretation of results.**What makes you a great scientific data and exploring relationships between material structures and properties.* You are curious about emerging AI\-based methods and motivated to explore their potential to advance image analysis, microstructure modelling and scientific data processing.* You communicate effectively in English and enjoy working collaboratively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment.Additional qualifications (nice to have)* Previous experience with microscopy, 3D image processing, numerical simulation or microstructure modelling is an advantage. title: Research Assistant Position with the TIM Chair
description: EinleitungstextEmployment: 50% for 6 months, with the possibility for extending hours and durationStart: By agreement, ideally as soon as possibleYou will be a core member of the research team, working closely with the principal investigators and postdoctoral researchers on data collection and early analysis. The position starts as soon as possible and runs through the first phase of fieldwork, with the possibility of extending hours and duration as the study develops.ProjekthintergrundThis project is a field study that examines how organizations plan for ultra-long time horizons. Our empirical setting is an organization responsible for the long-term containment of radioactive waste in a deep geological repository. Planning decisions there cannot be tested and feedback is limited/absent, so the project examines how people from different occupations and temporal frames coordinate, how organizations build and sustain confidence in decisions they cannot verify, and how far-future aspirations become concrete commitments in the present. The study is a longitudinal, multi-level qualitative case study that combines ethnographic observation, interviews, and analysis of organizational documents.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungResponsibilities include (but not limited to):Archival analysis: collecting, organizing, and indexing organizational artefacts such as organizational charts, title: Observatory Systems Engineer for LIFE Space Mission
description: EinleitungstextETH Zurich | Space is dedicated to advancing space activities both within ETH and in collaboration with external stakeholders. Our mission is to position ETH Zurich as Europe's leading institution in space research and education, while also being recognized as a premier partner for space-related projects within Switzerland and globally. ETH Zurich | Space was founded in 2022 and has been led by Prof. Dr. Thomas Zurbuchen since 2023. We are committed to driving technological advancements, shaping future policies, and inspiring the next generation of space scientists and engineers.ProjekthintergrundThe LIFE (Large Interferometer for Exoplanets) mission is an ETH Zurich-led concept for a space-based mid-infrared interferometer designed to characterize the atmospheres of nearby exoplanets and search for signs of habitability and life. As part of the ETH Zurich | Space engineering team, you will take a leading technical role in the development of LIFE, working closely with the mission's scientific and engineering teams, international partners, and industrial suppliers. Your work will primarily focus on prototype and precursor developments and, as the project evolves, may extend to elements of the full LIFE observatory. While LIFE will be your primary assignment, you may occasionally contribute to other ETH Zurich | Space missions. This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will take senior technical responsibility for systems engineering of the LIFE observatory and its prototype and precursor developments,  payload and spacecraft systems engineering, integration and test, and technical coordination. Working closely with the LIFE science team, mission leadership, international partners, and industrial suppliers, you will translate scientific objectives into technically feasible designs and lead their development and implementation across the participating organizations.As part of your role, you will:Lead and coordinate the technical development of assigned LIFE mission, observatory, and payload elements across the mission consortium and industrial partners, ensuring alignment on requirements, interfaces, schedules, and technical decisions in close collaboration with LIFE project management.Apply systems engineering practices and lessons learned from major space astrophysics missions, tailoring their implementation to the development and maturity of LIFE prototypes, precursor missions, and the full observatory.Translate science goals into mission objectives, requirements, and mission-level concepts of operations with scientific teams.Develop and manage requirements, specifications, and interface control documents, with requirements flowdown from mission to payload, instrument, and subsystem levels.Lead payload and spacecraft systems engineering across multiple institutions and suppliers, defining and controlling interfaces between instruments, optical assemblies, structures, spacecraft platforms, and other subsystems.Manage technical budgets for mass, power, thermal, data, pointing, and limited-life resources.Develop mission architectures covering launch and orbit selection, platform and payload architecture, ground segment, operations planning, launch campaign preparation, and in-orbit commissioning.Lead cross-discipline trade studies balancing scientific return, technology readiness, mission feasibility, schedule, and cost, particularly in early concept phases.Plan and lead manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test activities for LIFE-related instruments, payloads, and observatory elements, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering and test teams across participating institutions and suppliers.Develop and execute test plans and procedures from component to observatory level, including acceptance and post-delivery testing of externally supplied hardware and environmental testing (thermal vacuum, vibration, shock, EMI/EMC).Manage nonconformances; support or coordinate failure and anomaly review boards, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.Lead mission, payload, and instrument verification and validation, maintaining verification traceability and requirements relevant to scientific objectives.Lead technical risk identification, analysis, and mitigation using methods such as FMECA and fault tree analysis.Lead the technical preparation and coordination of mission and payload lifecycle reviews, including defining review objectives, technical content, and required documentation, and presenting engineering results and recommendations at MDR, PRR, SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, AR, and test readiness reviews.Provide technical oversight of suppliers developing flight and test hardware for LIFE, from specification through acceptance and delivery, and contribute to the integration and test infrastructure required for LIFE prototype, instrument, and observatory development.Coordinate additional technical resources from students and external partners with the project leadership team, mentor junior engineers and students, and contribute to teaching in the Space Systems program where appropriate.Contribute technical content to mission proposals and funding applications, including ESA, SSO, SNSF, and Innosuisse proposals.Ihr ProfilYou have extensive experience in space systems engineering and enjoy taking technical responsibility across disciplines and organizations. You combine sound engineering judgment with a practical approach to solving complex technical problems and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.We are looking for someone with:A degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, physics, or a related field, combined with substantial relevant professional experience. An advanced degree is an advantage.10+ years of relevant practical experience in space systems engineering, mission architecture, payload/instrument engineering, or spacecraft engineering.Systems engineering experience at the integrated payload or observatory level on the James Webb Space Telescope, Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, or a comparable large space astrophysics mission, ideally spanning element delivery through integration, test, launch and commissioning.Experience serving as technical authority or interface lead for an integrated payload or observatory composed of elements from different institutions and suppliers (e.g., telescope assembly, science instruments, and supporting structure).Demonstrated senior technical responsibility across the design, development, manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test lifecycle of space-flight missions, payloads, or instruments.Hands-on experience leading verification and validation across multiple requirement levels (e.g., mission, payload, and element), and leading environmental test campaigns at payload or observatory level, including thermal vacuum, dynamics, and EMI/EMC.Strong system-level analysis and trade-study skills, with an in-depth understanding of mission requirements, systems engineering principles, and lifecycle processes.Experience managing technical requirements, interfaces, and supplier deliverables across multiple institutions and industrial partners, including technical oversight of flight-hardware subcontracts.Experience with optical, infrared, or cryogenic science instruments, including cryogenic mechanisms, precision optical alignment, and their interfaces with telescope assemblies and observatory systems.Experience leading anomaly resolution and failure review boards, including root-cause analysis, fault tree analysis, and corrective action.Demonstrated technical leadership and sound engineering judgment, with the ability to establish priorities, resolve complex technical issues, and drive multidisciplinary engineering activities toward project milestones.Proven ability to lead and coordinate distributed, multi-institution teams without direct line authority, building consensus among scientists, engineers, and industry partners while maintaining technical accountability.Excellent command of written and spoken English. Wir bietenA dynamic, international, and interdisciplinary work environment at one of the leading technical universities in the world.A motivated team of people sharing a passion for space and the vision to strengthen and enhance space research and activities at ETH Zurich.An opportunity to help shape space missions from the very beginning.Neugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your application by Sunday January 10th, 2027 with the following documents:CVInstead of a motivation letter, a short max. 90-sec video about yourself and your motivation for this position*Job references (if available)DiplomasClick here to view the full job posting: https://jobs.ethz.ch/job/view/JOPG_ethz_7hC5224p5bJG3Fpggk

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. CEO's Assistant
===============

**JOIN OUR TEAM**

Hamilton is a watch brand founded in 1892 in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, combining American heritage, innovation and Swiss precision. With a rich history spanning railroads, aviation, the military and cinema\-\-with appearances in over 500 movies\-\-Hamilton has also pioneered major innovations, including the world's first electric watch in 1957 and the first LED digital watch in 1970\. Today, Hamilton is part of the Swatch Group.

Hamilton's culture is built around authenticity, innovation, excellence and a spirit of adventure. Its international team values people who bring bold ideas, creativity and the drive to turn them into reality. Joining Hamilton means becoming part of an iconic and innovative brand, where initiative, creativity and ambition are encouraged.

**THE JOB**

We are looking for a CEO's Assistant to join our Executive Office in Biel/Bienne, in an on\-site position with a workload of 80\-100%.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will provide reliable administrative and organizational support, helping ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations. Working closely with internal teams, subsidiaries and external partners, you will coordinate schedules, meetings, travel and corporate events, while handling sensitive information with discretion.

Key responsibilities and missions include, but are not limited to:

* Manage the CEO's calendar and correspondence, prioritise appointments and requests, and anticipate deadlines. Handle confidential information and occasional personal administrative requests with discretion.
* Organise domestic and international travel, including transport, accommodation, visas and accreditations.
* Coordinate management meetings, prepare agendas and materials, take minutes as needed and follow up on agreed actions.
* Organize corporate events in Switzerland and abroad, including market meetings and watch industry events. Welcome VIP guests and coordinate hospitality, suppliers, on\-site logistics and invoices.
* Support department heads and teams with documents, presentations, purchase orders, travel requests and expenses. Oversee filing, annual archiving, office supplies and employee watch loans.
* Contribute to cross\-functional projects and improve administrative processes in line with Swatch Group policies.


**YOUR SKILLS**

* Commercial or administrative qualification at Swiss vocational baccalaureate level (maturité professionnelle), or equivalent.
* Several years of experience in an administrative or executive support role in an international environment, including experience in an administrative or finance department.
* Experience managing executive schedules, international travel, corporate events and VIP visits.
* Clear communication and accurate writing, with an interest in finance and confidence working with figures and administrative systems.
* Fluency in written and spoken French and English. German is a strong asset.
* Advanced skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams, with the ability to learn new tools.


**YOUR SPIRIT**

You anticipate needs, follow through on commitments and stay calm when priorities shift. You work independently and collaboratively, with discretion, sound judgement and a strong sense of service.

**WANT TO JOIN?**

Federica Raho

description:
**Location:** Zurich

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead and conduct PCAOB integrated audits of Swiss based multinational companies or Swiss subsidiaries of U.S. companies

* Strong knowledge of US GAAS/PCAOB and SEC requirements and US audit methodology. Knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing (ISA) is a plus

From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Health \& Wellbeing**

We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**

We offer above-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.
